words.enDefinition: a form used for account

examples.en: The printed account form places debits on the left and credits on the right.
examples.zh: 印刷好的「账式」把借方排在左边，贷方排在右边。

examples.en: Every ledger page follows the same account form, whatever the department.
examples.zh: 无论哪个部门，每页分类账都采用同一种「账式」。

words.enDefinition: the books of account

examples.en: The tax office can inspect your accounting books for the past seven years.
examples.zh: 税务机关有权调阅你过去七年的「会计簿籍」。

examples.en: Grandfather kept the accounting books in copperplate handwriting until the shop went digital.
examples.zh: 店里数字化之前，祖父一直用工整的手写体登记「会计簿籍」。

words.enDefinition: an audit of accounting and financial

examples.en: The accounting and financial audit ran through April, ending one week late.
examples.zh: 「会计和财务审计」贯穿整个四月，比原计划晚一周收尾。

examples.en: Their accounting and financial audit covered both the ledgers and the funding statements.
examples.zh: 他们的「会计和财务审计」同时覆盖了账簿和资金报表。

words.enDefinition: activity related to accounting

examples.en: Most accounting activity now happens inside the software, not on paper.
examples.zh: 如今大部分「会计工作」都在软件里完成，不再用纸笔。

examples.en: Month-end closes are the busiest stretch of accounting activity in any finance team.
examples.zh: 月末结账是财务团队「会计工作」最繁忙的时段。

words.enDefinition: operations involving accounting for foreign

examples.en: Accounting for foreign operations means translating each branch into the group currency first.
examples.zh: 「国外经营活动会计」要求先把各分支按集团货币折算。

examples.en: Hyperinflation abroad complicates accounting for foreign operations more than exchange rates do.
examples.zh: 国外的恶性通胀给「国外经营活动会计」带来的麻烦比汇率更大。

collocations: calculate the accounting for foreign operations
compare the accounting for foreign operations
interpret the accounting for foreign operations

words.zhGloss: 外部报告会计(财务会计)
words.enDefinition: accounting intended for external reporting
acceptedZhAnswers: 外部报告会计(财务会计)

examples.en: Accounting for external reporting follows the standards, whatever managers privately prefer.
examples.zh: 「外部报告会计」必须遵循准则，管理层私下偏好无关紧要。

examples.en: Unlike the weekly flash report, accounting for external reporting lands once a year.
examples.zh: 与每周快报不同，「外部报告会计」一年才正式出一次成果。

words.enDefinition: accounting intended for assets acquisition

examples.en: Accounting for assets acquisition capitalises delivery, testing, and legal fees into the machine.
examples.zh: 「取得资产的会计处理」把运输、调试和法律费用资本化计入机器成本。

examples.en: The lecture on accounting for assets acquisition contrasts purchase with a leased alternative.
examples.zh: 关于「取得资产的会计处理」的讲座比较了购买与租赁两种方案。

words.enDefinition: an operation involving accounting for agency

examples.en: Accounting for agency operation records only commission, never the principal's goods.
examples.zh: 「代理商会计」只记录佣金收入，从不记录委托人的货物。

examples.en: Under accounting for agency operation, consigned stock stays off our balance sheet.
examples.zh: 在「代理商会计」下，寄售存货不进我们的资产负债表。

collocations: calculate the accounting for agency operation
compare the accounting for agency operation
interpret the accounting for agency operation

words.enDefinition: data used in accounting records and reports

examples.en: The dashboard pulls accounting data straight from the ledgers every morning.
examples.zh: 仪表盘每天早晨直接从分类账抽取「会计数据」。

examples.en: Clean accounting data matters more than clever charts when the bank asks questions.
examples.zh: 银行来问询时，干净的「会计数据」比漂亮的图表重要得多。

words.enDefinition: a departmentalization for accounting

examples.en: The group reviewed its accounting departmentalization after two subsidiaries reported late.
examples.zh: 两家子公司迟报账目后，集团重新审视了「会计事务管理组织」。

examples.en: Good accounting departmentalization splits recording, approval, and custody among different people.
examples.zh: 良好的「会计事务管理组织」把记账、审批和保管分给不同的人。

words.enDefinition: a document used in accounting

examples.en: Every accounting document must carry a reference number before it is filed.
examples.zh: 每份「会计凭证」归档前都必须编上索引号。

examples.en: The auditor sampled one accounting document per payment run for the whole year.
examples.zh: 审计员对全年每轮付款抽查一份「会计凭证」。

words.enDefinition: the entity for which accounts are kept

examples.en: The shop and the owner are separate, because each is a distinct accounting entity.
examples.zh: 店铺和店主要分开算账，因为各自都是独立的「会计主体」。

examples.en: Group accounting treats each subsidiary as one accounting entity within the consolidated whole.
examples.zh: 集团核算把每家子公司视为合并整体中的一个「会计主体」。

words.enDefinition: a department for accounting

examples.en: The accounting department occupies two desks and one very old safe downstairs.
examples.zh: 「会计部门」占了楼下两张办公桌和一个很旧的保险柜。

examples.en: Send every invoice to the accounting department the day it arrives.
examples.zh: 每张发票到达当天就送交「会计部门」。

words.enDefinition: accounting treatment of foreign subsidiaries

examples.en: Accounting for foreign subsidiaries adds translation adjustments to the group's deferred tax.
examples.zh: 「国外子公司会计」会把折算调整计入集团的递延所得税。

examples.en: The manual on accounting for foreign subsidiaries runs to two hundred pages.
examples.zh: 关于「国外子公司会计」的手册厚达两百页。

collocations: prioritise the accounting for foreign subsidiaries
standardise the accounting for foreign subsidiaries
monitor the accounting for foreign subsidiaries

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to account of credit

examples.en: Check the account of credit sales before approving any new wholesale customer.
examples.zh: 批准任何新批发客户之前，先查一查「赊销账户」。

examples.en: The account of credit sales grew faster than cash takings for three months.
examples.zh: 三个月来，「赊销账户」的增长速度一直超过现金收入。

words.enDefinition: a senior public accountant responsible for government accounts

examples.en: The accountant general signs the annual public accounts before parliament sees them.
examples.zh: 「会计主任」在年度公共账目提交议会之前签署。

examples.en: Our grandmother served as accountant general for the county council in the sixties.
examples.zh: 我们祖母上世纪六十年代曾任郡议会的「会计主任」。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage accounting

examples.en: Strong accounting control means nobody both writes the cheque and files it.
examples.zh: 有效的「会计控制」意味着没有人能既开票又归档。

examples.en: The franchise audits each outlet's accounting control twice a year, unannounced.
examples.zh: 特许总部每年两次不打招呼地审查各门店的「会计控制」。

words.zhGloss: 整美元记账；整数美元会计
words.enDefinition: an accounting presentation that rounds amounts to the nearest whole dollar and omits cents
acceptedZhAnswers: 整美元记账；整数美元会计

examples.en: Under whole-dollar accounting, the ledger simply never shows cents anywhere.
examples.zh: 按「整美元记账」，账簿里干脆任何地方都不出现美分。

examples.en: The old print shop kept whole-dollar accounting and rounded every supplier bill.
examples.zh: 那家老印刷店实行「整美元记账」，连供应商账单都四舍五入。

words.enDefinition: the cost of accounting

examples.en: Accounting cost counts the cheques written; economists also count what you gave up.
examples.zh: 「会计成本」只算实际付出的账款，经济学家还要算你放弃了什么。

examples.en: The van's accounting cost excludes the owner's unpaid weekend driving, naturally.
examples.zh: 货车的「会计成本」自然不含车主周末的无薪驾驶。

words.enDefinition: turnover arising from account receivable

examples.en: Account receivable turnover of eight means customers settle roughly every six weeks.
examples.zh: 「应收账款周转率」为八，意味着客户大约六周结一次账。

examples.en: We track account receivable turnover monthly and phone anyone who slows the average.
examples.zh: 我们按月跟踪「应收账款周转率」，谁拖慢均值就给谁打电话。

collocations: roll forward the account receivable turnover

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for abnormal

examples.en: The flood damage triggered abnormal depreciation on the ground-floor machinery.
examples.zh: 洪灾损失使底层机器计提了「特别折旧」。

examples.en: Tax rules allow abnormal depreciation when equipment is written down early for damage.
examples.zh: 设备因损坏提前减值时，税务规则允许计提「特别折旧」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for world

examples.en: Her thesis on world accounting compared chart of accounts across twelve countries.
examples.zh: 她关于「世界会计」的论文比较了十二个国家的会计科目表。

examples.en: The conference on world accounting drew delegates from every continent but one.
examples.zh: 「世界会计」研讨会吸引了除一个大洲之外各地的代表。

words.enDefinition: auditing of effectiveness

examples.en: Effectiveness auditing asks whether the programme actually changed outcomes, not just spent money.
examples.zh: 「效果审计」追问的是项目是否真正改变了结果，而不只是花了钱。

examples.en: The council commissioned effectiveness auditing for its youth employment scheme last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，市政会委托对青年就业计划开展「效果审计」。

words.enDefinition: a system for actual cost accounting

examples.en: An actual cost accounting system records what each job genuinely consumed, no estimates.
examples.zh: 「实际成本会计制度」记录每个订单真实耗用的资源，不做估计。

examples.en: The workshop abandoned its actual cost accounting system when standards made variances visible.
examples.zh: 标准成本让差异现形之后，车间便放弃了「实际成本会计制度」。

collocations: test the actual cost accounting system
refine the actual cost accounting system
compare the actual cost accounting system

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning accounts payable

examples.en: Accounts payable trade covers goods suppliers only, never the utility companies.
examples.zh: 「应付贸易账款」只涵盖货品供应商，不含公用事业公司。

examples.en: The covenant measures accounts payable trade against average monthly purchases.
examples.zh: 该契约条款用月均采购额来衡量「应付贸易账款」。

collocations: roll forward the accounts payable trade

words.enDefinition: published surveys of accounting trends and techniques

examples.en: The annual survey on accounting trends and techniques tracks disclosure practice across listed firms.
examples.zh: 年度「会计趋势和会计技术」调查追踪上市公司的披露实务。

examples.en: Her dissertation cited accounting trends and techniques surveys from three different regulators.
examples.zh: 她的论文引用了三家监管机构发布的「会计趋势和会计技术」调查。

words.enDefinition: a voucher supporting accounting

examples.en: Each payment needs an approved accounting voucher before the cashier releases cash.
examples.zh: 出纳放款之前，每笔付款都必须有经批准的「会计凭证」。

examples.en: The clerk stamps every accounting voucher with the payment date and number.
examples.zh: 书记员给每份「会计凭证」盖上付款日期和编号。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of warrants

examples.en: Warrants payable sit unpaid until the treasury actually releases the funds.
examples.zh: 在国库实际拨款之前，「应付支付命令」一直挂账未付。

examples.en: The county lists warrants payable separately from ordinary commercial creditors.
examples.zh: 该郡把「应付支付命令」与普通商业债权人分开列示。

words.enDefinition: the specialised words and phrases used in accounting

examples.en: The glossary standardises accounting terminology across all eleven overseas offices.
examples.zh: 术语表统一了全部十一个海外办事处的「会计用语」。

examples.en: New hires stumble over accounting terminology like carry forward and write off.
examples.zh: 新员工常被「结转」「核销」这类「会计用语」绊住。

words.enDefinition: a document issued by a warehouse acknowledging stored goods, often used as a document of title

examples.en: The bank lends against the warehouse receipt rather than the coffee itself.
examples.zh: 银行凭「仓单」放贷，而不是直接押咖啡豆本身。

examples.en: A negotiable warehouse receipt lets the grain change owners without leaving the silo.
examples.zh: 可转让「仓单」让谷物不用出筒仓就能易主。

words.enDefinition: earnings measured after tax

examples.en: Earnings after tax rose despite the one-off reorganisation charge in March.
examples.zh: 尽管三月有一笔一次性重组费用，「课税后收益」仍实现了增长。

examples.en: We distribute half the earnings after tax and retain the rest for equipment.
examples.zh: 我们把一半「课税后收益」分掉，其余留存购置设备。

words.enDefinition: operations involving accounting

examples.en: Month-end accounting operations now finish in two days instead of five.
examples.zh: 月末「会计操作」现在两天收工，不再需要五天。

examples.en: The manual lists every accounting operation that requires a second signature.
examples.zh: 手册列明了每一项需要双人签字的「会计操作」。

words.enDefinition: management of accounting

examples.en: Good accounting management spots the runaway courier spend before the quarter closes.
examples.zh: 得力的「会计管理」能在季度结束前发现失控的快递开支。

examples.en: The partners credit their accounting management overhaul for surviving the fee pressure.
examples.zh: 合伙人把扛住降价压力归功于「会计管理」的全面整改。

words.enDefinition: accounting methods and records for inventories

examples.en: Accounting for inventories changed when the group moved from FIFO to weighted average.
examples.zh: 集团从先进先出法改为加权平均法时，「存货会计」随之调整。

examples.en: The chapter on accounting for inventories ends with the net realisable value test.
examples.zh: 「存货会计」那一章以可变现净值测试收尾。

words.enDefinition: accounting methods and records for management

examples.en: Accounting for management serves decisions inside the firm, not outside investors.
examples.zh: 「管理会计」服务于企业内部的决策，而不是外部投资者。

examples.en: Unlike the statutory accounts, accounting for management can break any rule it likes.
examples.zh: 与法定报表不同，「管理会计」可以不拘任何格式。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage accounting for management

examples.en: Accounting for management control compares each depot's spend against its own budget.
examples.zh: 「管理控制会计」把每个仓库的开支与自身预算对比。

examples.en: The board reads accounting for management control reports before every quarterly review.
examples.zh: 每次季度评审之前，董事会都会先读「管理控制会计」报告。

collocations: improve the accounting for management control
measure the accounting for management control
benchmark the accounting for management control

words.enDefinition: accounting intended for management planning

examples.en: Accounting for management planning projects cash needs for the whole expansion.
examples.zh: 「计划管理会计」为整个扩张计划预测现金需求。

examples.en: Accounting for management planning had triple-checked the rent before the lease was ever signed.
examples.zh: 签租约之前，「计划管理会计」已把租金核了三遍。

words.enDefinition: an identity that always holds in accounting equations

examples.en: The accounting identity holds by construction: assets always equal liabilities plus equity.
examples.zh: 「会计恒等式」天然成立：资产永远等于负债加所有者权益。

examples.en: No clever transaction can break the accounting identity, only shuffle it around.
examples.zh: 再巧妙的交易也打不破「会计恒等式」，只能把它挪来挪去。

words.enDefinition: an information for accounting

examples.en: Investors ultimately price the company on accounting information, whatever the rumours say.
examples.zh: 无论传言如何，投资者最终仍依据「会计资料」为公司定价。

examples.en: The regulator demanded accounting information covering every related-party loan since 2021.
examples.zh: 监管机构要求提供 2021 年以来全部关联方贷款的「会计资料」。

words.enDefinition: a calculation method for accounting

examples.en: The spreadsheet hides an accounting formula that recalculates margin as costs change.
examples.zh: 表格里藏着一个「会计公式」，成本一变毛利就自动重算。

examples.en: Examiners award full marks once the accounting formula and workings both appear.
examples.zh: 只要「会计公式」和演算过程都写出来，阅卷就给满分。

words.enDefinition: official rules governing accounting

examples.en: New accounting regulations force smaller firms to file digital records monthly.
examples.zh: 新的「会计规则」要求小企业按月提交电子账目记录。

examples.en: Compliance teams rewrote their manuals the day the accounting regulations were gazetted.
examples.zh: 「会计规则」在宪报公布的当天，合规团队就重写了手册。

words.enDefinition: a profession for accounting

examples.en: The accounting profession guards its ethics code more tightly than its fees.
examples.zh: 「会计职业」对职业道德准则的守护比对收费更严。

examples.en: Her mother spent forty years in the accounting profession, finally as a partner.
examples.zh: 她母亲在「会计职业」干了四十年，最后当上了合伙人。

words.enDefinition: a process used for accounting

examples.en: The accounting process runs from source document to trial balance in nine steps.
examples.zh: 「会计处理步序」从原始凭证到试算平衡表共九步。

examples.en: Automation compressed the accounting process, but someone still must understand each step.
examples.zh: 自动化压缩了「会计处理步序」，但仍须有人真正理解每一步。

words.enDefinition: fundamental rules applied to accounting

examples.en: Accrual and prudence are the accounting principles underneath every published statement.
examples.zh: 权责发生与谨慎性是支撑每份公布报表的「会计原理」。

examples.en: He teaches accounting principles through the story of one fictitious greengrocer's year.
examples.zh: 他用一个虚构蔬果店一整年的故事来讲授「会计原理」。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of vouchers

examples.en: Vouchers payable include the approved invoices waiting for Friday's payment run.
examples.zh: 「应付凭单」包括已批准、等待周五付款批次的发票。

examples.en: The clerk files vouchers payable numerically so any missing voucher shows instantly.
examples.zh: 书记员按编号归档「应付凭单」，缺哪张一眼就能看出。

words.enDefinition: a register of voucher payable

examples.en: The voucher payable register lists every approved claim with its due date.
examples.zh: 「应付凭单登记簿」逐笔列出每项已批准付款及其到期日。

examples.en: Cross the voucher payable register against the bank statement before month-end close.
examples.zh: 月末结账前，把「应付凭单登记簿」与银行对账单核对一遍。

words.enDefinition: a register of voucher

examples.en: The voucher register totals each supplier's pending payments at a glance.
examples.zh: 翻一眼「应付凭单登记簿」，各家供应商的待付款一目了然。

examples.en: Every entry in the voucher register carries its own approval stamp.
examples.zh: 「应付凭单登记簿」中的每条记录都盖有各自的审批章。

words.enDefinition: a system for voucher

examples.en: Under the voucher system, no supplier gets paid without a numbered voucher.
examples.zh: 在「应付凭单制」下，没有编号凭单就不向任何供应商付款。

examples.en: The voucher system caught the duplicate payment before the cheque ever printed.
examples.zh: 支票还没打印，「应付凭单制」就把那笔重复付款拦了下来。

words.enDefinition: turnover arising from accounts receivable

examples.en: Accounts receivable turnover of six tells us customers pay about every two months.
examples.zh: 「应收账款周转率」为六，说明客户大约两个月才结一次账。

examples.en: The bank compares our accounts receivable turnover against the trade association average.
examples.zh: 银行把我们的「应收账款周转率」与同业公会均值作比较。

collocations: tie out the accounts receivable turnover

words.zhGloss: 应付工厂工资帐户(科目)
words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track accrued factory payroll
acceptedZhAnswers: 应付工厂工资帐户(科目)

examples.en: The accrued factory payroll account holds the wages earned during the final week.
examples.zh: 「应付工厂工资账户」记录最后一周已挣得但未发的工资。

examples.en: We clear the accrued factory payroll account on the first payday of January.
examples.zh: 一月第一个发薪日，我们就会结清「应付工厂工资账户」。

words.enDefinition: a wage of management used in professional practice

examples.en: The wage of management appears as a separate line from shop-floor pay.
examples.zh: 「管理阶层工资」与车间工资分开列示。

examples.en: Union negotiators questioned why the wage of management rose while crew pay froze.
examples.zh: 工会谈判代表质疑：船员工资冻结，「管理阶层工资」为何还在涨。

words.enDefinition: a planned approach for wage payment

examples.en: The new wage payment plan pays Fridays, with overtime added the following week.
examples.zh: 新的「工资支付计划」每周五发薪，加班费次周补入。

examples.en: Crews backed the wage payment plan once piece rates were dropped entirely.
examples.zh: 计件工资全部取消后，船员们都支持这项「工资支付计划」。

words.enDefinition: treaties allocating taxing rights between countries

examples.en: The double tax treaties decide which country taxes the Singapore royalties.
examples.zh: 由「税收协定」决定由哪个国家对新加坡的特许权使用费征税。

examples.en: Our group relies on tax treaties to stop the same dividend being taxed twice.
examples.zh: 集团依靠「税收协定」避免同一笔股利被双重征税。

words.enDefinition: earnings from taxable

examples.en: Tips count as taxable earnings, whatever the cash box suggests.
examples.zh: 无论钱箱怎么说，小费都算「应纳税的收入」。

examples.en: Her taxable earnings fell just under the threshold after pension relief.
examples.zh: 扣除养老金减免后，她的「应纳税的收入」刚好压在门槛之下。

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in tax-option

examples.en: As a tax-option corporation, the firm is taxed like a partnership instead.
examples.zh: 作为「纳税选择公司」，这家企业按合伙方式课税。

examples.en: The owners elected tax-option corporation status to dodge the double dividend tax.
examples.zh: 股东们选择「纳税选择公司」身份，避开股利的双重征税。

words.enDefinition: accounting for taxable

examples.en: Taxable accounting keeps a parallel book for what the revenue actually accepts.
examples.zh: 「纳税会计」另立一套账，专门记录税务局认可的内容。

examples.en: Depreciation differs between the statutory accounts and the taxable accounting schedules.
examples.zh: 法定报表与「纳税会计」明细表中的折旧口径并不相同。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to tax payment

examples.en: Keep every tax payment receipt; the audit starts next month.
examples.zh: 每张「纳税凭证」都要保存好，下个月就开始审计了。

examples.en: The bank asked for the tax payment receipt before releasing the import licence.
examples.zh: 银行要先收到「纳税凭证」，才签发进口许可证。

collocations: tie out the tax payment receipt

words.enDefinition: a factoring concerning receivables

examples.en: Factoring of receivables released the cash we needed for the Christmas stock.
examples.zh: 「应收账款的转让」盘活了我们备圣诞货所需的现金。

examples.en: With factoring of receivables, the factor chases the customers, not our credit team.
examples.zh: 通过「应收账款的转让」，催收客户账款的是保理商，而不是我们的信用团队。

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record factory expense

examples.en: The factory expense ledger splits heat, power, and repairs into separate columns.
examples.zh: 「制造费用分类账」把供暖、电力和维修分成单独的栏位。

examples.en: Each Friday the foreman initials the week's entries in the factory expense ledger.
examples.zh: 每周五，工头都在「制造费用分类账」的当周记录上签字确认。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of anticipation warrants

examples.en: Anticipation warrants payable cover the orders promised before the tax receipts arrive.
examples.zh: 在税款到账之前先承诺的订单，记入「预计应付支付凭单」。

examples.en: The city funds anticipation warrants payable from next quarter's property taxes.
examples.zh: 市政府用下一季度的财产税来偿付「预计应付支付凭单」。

collocations: roll forward the anticipation warrants payable

words.enDefinition: the process of paying staff related to factory

examples.en: Factory payroll this month includes the double shift premiums from March.
examples.zh: 本月「工厂发放的工资额」包含三月的双班津贴。

examples.en: Rising factory payroll squeezed margins faster than the steel price did.
examples.zh: 「工厂发放的工资额」的上涨对利润率的挤压比钢价还快。

words.enDefinition: an audit of tax

examples.en: The tax audit lasted three days and examined every diesel receipt.
examples.zh: 「税务审计」持续了三天，连每张柴油发票都查了一遍。

examples.en: Random selection put our little farm into the annual tax audit pool.
examples.zh: 随机抽选让我们的小农场进了年度「税务审计」名单。

words.zhGloss: 制造(间接)费用帐户(科目)
words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track factory overhead
acceptedZhAnswers: 制造(间接)费用帐户(科目)

examples.en: Heat, light, and supervisory pay all gather in the factory overhead account.
examples.zh: 取暖、照明和主管工资都归入「制造费用账户」。

examples.en: The debit side of the factory overhead account grew faster than output did.
examples.zh: 「制造费用账户」的借方增长得比产量还快。

words.enDefinition: accounting for tax

examples.en: Tax accounting follows the revenue's rules, which rarely match the statute books.
examples.zh: 「税务会计」遵循税务局的规则，而那与法典很少一致。

examples.en: Our tax accounting calendar starts each January with the payroll year-end returns.
examples.zh: 我们的「税务会计」日程从每年一月的工资年度申报开始。

words.enDefinition: a difference in tax rates or tax treatment

examples.en: The tax differential between the two counties changed where the warehouse went.
examples.zh: 两郡之间的「税收差别」改变了仓库选址。

examples.en: Investors weigh the tax differential before choosing bonds over savings accounts.
examples.zh: 投资者在债券与储蓄账户之间取舍时，会掂量「税收差别」。

words.zhGloss: 只以收益为目的的关税
words.enDefinition: a tariff imposed mainly to raise revenue
acceptedZhAnswers: 只以收益为目的的关税

examples.en: A tariff for revenue only protects no industry; it simply funds the state.
examples.zh: 「只以收益为目的」的关税不保护任何产业，纯粹为国库筹资。

examples.en: The levy on tea was a tariff for revenue only, kept deliberately low.
examples.zh: 茶叶税是「只以收益为目的」的关税，刻意维持在低位。

words.enDefinition: the cost of depreciable

examples.en: Depreciable cost equals purchase price minus the salvage we expect at the end.
examples.zh: 「应计折旧成本」等于购价减去预计的期末残值。

examples.en: We spread the depreciable cost evenly across the oven's ten-year life.
examples.zh: 我们把「应计折旧成本」在烤箱十年寿命内平均分摊。

words.enDefinition: assets associated with depreciable

examples.en: Machines, vans, and shelving are all depreciable assets on our register.
examples.zh: 机器、货车和货架都是我们登记册上的「应计折旧资产」。

examples.en: Land is excluded from depreciable assets because it does not wear out.
examples.zh: 土地不会损耗，因此不属于「应计折旧资产」。

words.enDefinition: an audit of final

examples.en: The final audit begins the week after the stocktake finishes.
examples.zh: 「期末审计」在盘点结束后的那一周进场。

examples.en: Half the team moved from interim testing straight into the final audit.
examples.zh: 一半人马从中期测试直接转入「期末审计」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for fiduciary

examples.en: Fiduciary accounting separates the trustee's own money from the estate's.
examples.zh: 「财产信托会计」把受托人自有资金与遗产资金严格分开。

examples.en: The solicitor's fiduciary accounting showed every distribution made to the grandchildren.
examples.zh: 律师的「财产信托会计」记录了付给孙辈的每一笔分配。

words.enDefinition: accounting focused on preparing general-purpose financial statements for external users

examples.en: Financial accounting speaks to outsiders; cost accounting whispers to managers.
examples.zh: 「财务会计」对外部人说话，成本会计则对经理们低语。

examples.en: Her first module of financial accounting ended with a full set of fictional statements.
examples.zh: 她的「财务会计」第一单元以一整套虚构报表结束。

words.zhGloss: 由工资中扣除应缴年金贡献的付款方法
words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for superannuation
acceptedZhAnswers: 由工资中扣除应缴年金贡献的付款方法

examples.en: The superannuation payment leaves your wages before the tax is worked out.
examples.zh: 「年金缴款」在计税之前就从工资中扣走了。

examples.en: Her superannuation payment is nine percent of salary, deducted every fortnight automatically.
examples.zh: 她的「年金缴款」为薪金的百分之九，每两周自动扣缴。

words.enDefinition: an amount deducted or set aside for depreciation

examples.en: The depreciation allowance accumulates in a credit column beside the asset's cost.
examples.zh: 「折旧备抵」在资产成本旁的贷方栏内逐年累积。

examples.en: Taxpayers claim the depreciation allowance even in years the machine sits idle.
examples.zh: 即使机器整年闲置，纳税人仍可申报「折旧备抵」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for depreciation

examples.en: Depreciation accounting spreads the lathe's price across the years it actually earns.
examples.zh: 「折旧会计」把车床的价款分摊到它实际创收的年份里。

examples.en: The chapter on depreciation accounting compares straight-line with reducing-balance charges.
examples.zh: 「折旧会计」那一章比较了直线法与余额递减法。

words.enDefinition: a time span used for depreciation

examples.en: The depreciation period for computers now runs three years, not five.
examples.zh: 电脑的「折旧期」现在是三年，不再是五年。

examples.en: Management reviews every depreciation period once the usage pattern changes materially.
examples.zh: 使用模式一旦发生重大变化，管理层就会复核每项「折旧期」。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling depreciation reducing charge

examples.en: Under the depreciation reducing charge method, the first year absorbs the biggest hit.
examples.zh: 按「递减费用折旧法」，第一年承担的折旧最重。

examples.en: The depreciation reducing charge method matches the van's fastest loss of value upfront.
examples.zh: 「递减费用折旧法」把货车价值跌得最快的那段放在了前头。

collocations: apply the depreciation reducing charge method
adopt the depreciation reducing charge method
document the depreciation reducing charge method

words.enDefinition: a line of depreciation-straight

examples.en: Under depreciation-straight line, the shelving sheds exactly four hundred every year.
examples.zh: 按「直线折旧法」，货架每年正好折旧四百英镑。

examples.en: Depreciation-straight line suits leases, whose benefit arrives evenly month after month.
examples.zh: 「直线折旧法」适合租赁资产——收益逐月均匀流入。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling depreciation-revenue

examples.en: The depreciation-revenue method ties each year's charge to the takings that year.
examples.zh: 「营业收入折旧法」把每年的折旧与当年营业收入挂钩。

examples.en: Under the depreciation-revenue method, a bumper season absorbs a heavier depreciation charge.
examples.zh: 在「营业收入折旧法」下，丰收年景就多担一些折旧。

words.zhGloss: 附属(子公司)营业收入明细帐
words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record subsidiary revenue
acceptedZhAnswers: 附属(子公司)营业收入明细帐

examples.en: The subsidiary revenue ledger breaks the cinema's takings down by screen.
examples.zh: 「附属营业收入明细账」把电影院的票房按影厅逐项拆分。

examples.en: Head office reconciles each subsidiary revenue ledger against the banked totals weekly.
examples.zh: 总部每周把各本「附属营业收入明细账」与入账合计核对。

words.enDefinition: accounting for subsidiary company

examples.en: Subsidiary company accounting keeps each unit's statutory books ready for local filing.
examples.zh: 「附属公司会计」保证各子公司的法定账册随时可供当地申报。

examples.en: Inter-company loans complicate subsidiary company accounting more than anything else.
examples.zh: 公司间借款给「附属公司会计」带来的麻烦最大。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling depreciation-unit cost

examples.en: Under the depreciation-unit cost method, each brick fired carries a sliver of kiln cost.
examples.zh: 按「单位成本折旧法」，每烧一块砖都分摊一小片窑炉成本。

examples.en: The depreciation-unit cost method suits equipment whose wear tracks output exactly.
examples.zh: 「单位成本折旧法」适合磨损与产量严格对应的设备。

collocations: tie out the depreciation-unit cost method

words.enDefinition: a depreciation-sum concerning year digit

examples.en: Under the depreciation-sum of year digit rule, year one takes five-fifteenths of the cost.
examples.zh: 按「年数合计折旧法」，第一年计提成本的十五分之五。

examples.en: The depreciation-sum of year digit approach front-loads charges on fast-obsolete kit.
examples.zh: 「年数合计折旧法」把折旧集中在很快过时的设备前几年。

words.enDefinition: the cost of depreciation-percentage of original

examples.en: Under the depreciation-percentage of original cost method, the charge never changes with value.
examples.zh: 按「原始成本定率折旧法」，折旧额从不随价值波动。

examples.en: The depreciation-percentage of original cost rule keeps the books simple for small yards.
examples.zh: 「原始成本定率折旧法」让小作坊的账目保持简单。

collocations: estimate the depreciation-percentage of original cost
allocate the depreciation-percentage of original cost
cut the depreciation-percentage of original cost

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling depreciation-age-life

examples.en: The depreciation-age-life method weights the charge by how much of the life is spent.
examples.zh: 「寿限折旧法」按寿命已耗用的比例来确定折旧负担。

examples.en: Under the depreciation-age-life method, the older crane carries a smaller annual charge.
examples.zh: 在「寿限折旧法」下，越老的吊车年折旧反而越小。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling depreciation-gross earning

examples.en: The depreciation-gross earning method charges the mine a share of every ton sold.
examples.zh: 「总收益提成折旧法」按每吨售出矿石提成计提矿山的折旧。

examples.en: Railways once used the depreciation-gross earning method, tying charges to ticket takings.
examples.zh: 铁路曾用「总收益提成折旧法」，把折旧与客票收入绑定。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling depreciation-inventory

examples.en: Under the depreciation-inventory method, tools are revalued each year and the drop is the charge.
examples.zh: 按「盘存折旧法」，工具逐年重新估值，跌多少折旧就是多少。

examples.en: The depreciation-inventory method suits cheap tooling where precision hardly pays.
examples.zh: 「盘存折旧法」适合低价工装——精细核算并不划算。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for depreciation-equal-annual

examples.en: The depreciation-equal-annual payment approach charges exactly the same amount every single year.
examples.zh: 「等额年金折旧」每年计提的折旧费用分毫不差。

examples.en: With depreciation-equal-annual payment, budgeting the annual depreciation expense takes one multiplication.
examples.zh: 采用等额年金折旧，编年度「折旧费用」预算只需乘一次。

words.enDefinition: accounting for traditional cost

examples.en: Traditional cost accounting spreads overhead by labour hours, machines or no machines.
examples.zh: 无论有没有机器，「传统成本会计」都按人工工时分摊间接费用。

examples.en: Activity-based costing fixed what traditional cost accounting got wrong about our small orders.
examples.zh: 作业成本法修正了「传统成本会计」对我们小订单的误判。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of trade note

examples.en: The customer signed a trade note receivable due ninety days after delivery.
examples.zh: 客户签发了一张交货后九十天到期的「应收商业票据」。

examples.en: We discount the trade note receivable at the bank when cash runs tight.
examples.zh: 现金吃紧时，我们就拿「应收商业票据」去银行贴现。

collocations: tie out the trade note receivable

words.enDefinition: a time span used for trade payable turnover

examples.en: The trade payable turnover period stretched from thirty to fifty-five days.
examples.zh: 「应付货款周转期」从三十天拉长到了五十五天。

examples.en: A longer trade payable turnover period helps cash but scares the suppliers.
examples.zh: 「应付货款周转期」变长有利于现金，却让供应商心慌。

collocations: sample the trade payable turnover period
vouch the trade payable turnover period
tie out the trade payable turnover period

words.enDefinition: the price charged in transfer transactions

examples.en: The transfer price between the two plants is set at cost plus five percent.
examples.zh: 两个工厂之间的「转让价格」按成本加价百分之五确定。

examples.en: Tax authorities challenge any transfer price that shifts profit into low-tax countries.
examples.zh: 凡是把利润转移到低税国的「转让价格」，税务当局都会质疑。

words.enDefinition: an allowance for depreciation used in professional practice

examples.en: The allowance for depreciation sits against the fleet on the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 资产负债表上，「备抵折旧」与车队资产相抵列示。

examples.en: Additions this year barely outgrew the allowance for depreciation on the old presses.
examples.zh: 今年新增资产勉强跑赢了旧压机的「备抵折旧」。

words.enDefinition: money received from total taxable

examples.en: Rental profit pushed her total taxable income over the higher-rate line.
examples.zh: 房租收益把她的「总的应纳税收益」推过了高税率线。

examples.en: Add every source together to reach the total taxable income for the year.
examples.zh: 把各项所得加总，才是全年「总的应纳税收益」。

words.enDefinition: an audit of amateur

examples.en: The village hall relies on an amateur audit by two retired teachers.
examples.zh: 村活动室的账目靠两位退休教师做「非专业审计」。

examples.en: An amateur audit can catch obvious errors, but never replaces a qualified opinion.
examples.zh: 「非专业审计」能查出明显差错，却永远替代不了合格审计意见。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of trade acceptance

examples.en: The buyer accepted our draft, creating a trade acceptance receivable due in May.
examples.zh: 买方承兑了我们的汇票，形成一笔五月到期的「应收贸易承兑汇票」。

examples.en: Banks discount a trade acceptance receivable more readily than an open invoice.
examples.zh: 银行对「应收贸易承兑汇票」的贴现，比普通挂账发票爽快得多。

collocations: roll forward the trade acceptance receivable

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of trade accounts

examples.en: Trade accounts receivable exclude staff loans and the deposit with the landlord.
examples.zh: 「贸易应收账款」不包括员工借款和付给房东的押金。

examples.en: Insurance covers ninety percent of our trade accounts receivable against customer failure.
examples.zh: 保险为我们的「贸易应收账款」提供九成的客户违约保障。

collocations: tie out the trade accounts receivable

words.enDefinition: a tariff applied to trade diverting

examples.en: A trade diverting tariff pushes buyers toward cheaper suppliers outside the bloc.
examples.zh: 「转移贸易关税」把采购逼向集团之外的廉价供应商。

examples.en: Economists call it a trade diverting tariff when trade shifts from efficient to protected sources.
examples.zh: 当贸易从高效率来源转向受保护来源时，经济学家称之为「转移贸易关税」。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of trade debtors accounts

examples.en: Trade debtors accounts receivable carry only genuine credit customers, never sister companies.
examples.zh: 「销货客户应收账款」只记真正的赊销客户，绝不混入兄弟公司。

examples.en: The factor advanced eighty percent of the trade debtors accounts receivable balance.
examples.zh: 保理商按「销货客户应收账款」余额预付了八成。

collocations: sample the trade debtors accounts receivable
vouch the trade debtors accounts receivable
tie out the trade debtors accounts receivable

words.enDefinition: a warehouse for ex bond

examples.en: The spirits are quoted ex bond warehouse, duty still unpaid inside.
examples.zh: 这些烈酒按「保税仓库交货」报价，仓库里的税还没缴。

examples.en: Buy the whisky ex bond warehouse and the duty lands on your account.
examples.zh: 按「保税仓库交货」买下威士忌，关税就落到你的账上。

words.enDefinition: accounting for transnational

examples.en: Transnational accounting merges statements prepared under four different reporting frameworks.
examples.zh: 「跨国公司会计」要把按四种不同框架编制的报表合并起来。

examples.en: Her seminar on transnational accounting tackled currency translation and transfer pricing together.
examples.zh: 她的「跨国公司会计」研讨课同时讲折算与转让定价。

words.enDefinition: accounting for analytical

examples.en: Analytical accounting breaks every pound of spend into projects and phases.
examples.zh: 「分析会计」把每一英镑开支拆到项目和阶段。

examples.en: Grant funders demand analytical accounting down to the last printing cartridge.
examples.zh: 助学金拨付方要求「分析会计」细到最后一个打印墨盒。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track expense adjust

examples.en: The expense adjust account corrects last month's double-counted courier charges.
examples.zh: 「费用调整账户」更正了上月重复计算的快递费。

examples.en: Year-end rebates flow through the expense adjust account, not through purchases.
examples.zh: 年终返利走「费用调整账户」，不走采购科目。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of expenses

examples.en: Expenses payable at year end include the December electricity and the cleaner.
examples.zh: 年末的「应付费用」包括十二月的电费和保洁费。

examples.en: The landlord's invoice joined expenses payable the day the quarter ended.
examples.zh: 季度一结束，房东的账单就进了「应付费用」。

words.enDefinition: a clerk who records time and cost data

examples.en: The time and cost clerk clocks every repair hour against the right job.
examples.zh: 「计时和成本会计员」把每个修理工时记到正确的订单上。

examples.en: Our time and cost clerk spotted the missing overtime before payroll ran.
examples.zh: 工资发放之前，「计时和成本会计员」就发现了漏掉的加班。

collocations: appoint a time and cost clerk
brief the time and cost clerk
replace the time and cost clerk

words.enDefinition: accounting for modern management

examples.en: Modern management accounting replaced gut feel with dashboards and driver analysis.
examples.zh: 「现代管理会计」用仪表盘和动因分析取代了拍脑袋。

examples.en: The factory embraced modern management accounting only after the second loss-making year.
examples.zh: 直到第二个亏损年度之后，工厂才拥抱「现代管理会计」。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track miscellaneous receipt

examples.en: Scrap sales and found cash both land in the miscellaneous receipt account.
examples.zh: 废料销售收入和捡到的现金都记入「杂项收入账户」。

examples.en: Auditors always inspect the miscellaneous receipt account for unexplained deposits.
examples.zh: 审计员总会检查「杂项收入账户」里说不清来路的进账。

collocations: tie out the miscellaneous receipt account

words.enDefinition: a tax levied on a corporation’s taxable profits

examples.en: Corporate profits tax swallowed a fifth of the dividend pool this year.
examples.zh: 今年「公司利润税」吃掉了分红池的五分之一。

examples.en: Offshore hubs cut corporate profits tax but added compliance costs overnight.
examples.zh: 离岸中心降低了「公司利润税」，合规成本却一夜倍增。

words.enDefinition: accounting for institutional

examples.en: Institutional accounting for the charity follows fund rather than profit logic.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构的「机关会计」遵循基金逻辑，而非利润逻辑。

examples.en: Her career in institutional accounting began in a county hospital's finance office.
examples.zh: 她的「机关会计」生涯始于一家郡立医院的财务室。

words.enDefinition: accounting for institute of management

examples.en: The institute of management accounting publishes the syllabus every second spring.
examples.zh: 「管理会计协会」每两年在春季发布一次考试大纲。

examples.en: Membership of the institute of management accounting opened the plant controller's job.
examples.zh: 正是「管理会计协会」会员资格让他拿到了工厂主计长的职位。

words.enDefinition: a mechanics of accounting used in professional practice

examples.en: The mechanics of accounting clicked for her the day debits met credits.
examples.zh: 借方与贷方相遇的那天，「会计结构」在她脑中豁然贯通。

examples.en: Volunteers learn the mechanics of accounting from a single colour-coded ledger page.
examples.zh: 志愿者从一页彩色编码的分类账学会「会计结构」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for mercantile

examples.en: Mercantile accounting centres on goods bought, goods sold, and the margin between.
examples.zh: 「商业会计」关注的是进货、出货，以及两者之间的差价。

examples.en: The draper's shop ran on plain mercantile accounting for three generations.
examples.zh: 那家布店三代人只靠朴素的「商业会计」经营。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling combined depreciation-and-upkeep

examples.en: Under the combined depreciation-and-upkeep method, servicing and value loss share one charge.
examples.zh: 按「折旧与保养合并法」，保养费与价值损耗合并计提。

examples.en: The combined depreciation-and-upkeep method keeps lift costs level across the contract.
examples.zh: 「折旧与保养合并法」让电梯费用在整个合同期内保持平稳。

words.enDefinition: amounts collected or to be collected on behalf of customers

examples.en: Collections receivable for customers sit apart from our own sales balances.
examples.zh: 「应收代收客户款」与我们自身的销售余额分开列示。

examples.en: The agent remits collections receivable for customers every Friday, statement attached.
examples.zh: 代理人每周五汇交「应收代收客户款」，并附对账单。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track merchandise inventory

examples.en: The merchandise inventory account moves whenever goods arrive or a sale completes.
examples.zh: 每当到货或成交，「商品存货账户」就会发生变动。

examples.en: Perpetual updates keep the merchandise inventory account close to the shelf reality.
examples.zh: 永续更新让「商品存货账户」始终贴近货架实况。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in merchandise

examples.en: The fire insurance valued our merchandise inventory at cost, not at retail.
examples.zh: 火险按成本而非零售价评估我们的「商品盘存」。

examples.en: Counting merchandise inventory took the whole team most of Sunday night.
examples.zh: 清点「商品盘存」让全组人熬了大半个周日夜晚。

words.zhGloss: 商品销售应收帐款比率
words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates merchandise receivables
acceptedZhAnswers: 商品销售应收帐款比率

examples.en: A rising merchandise receivables ratio warned that credit terms were loosening.
examples.zh: 「商品销售应收账款比率」上升，预警信用条款正在放宽。

examples.en: The bank compares our merchandise receivables ratio with the sector median.
examples.zh: 银行把我们的「商品销售应收账款比率」与行业中位数比较。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates merchandise stock turnover

examples.en: The merchandise stock turnover ratio hit ten after the store trimmed slow lines.
examples.zh: 砍掉滞销品后，门店的「商品存货周转率」达到了十次。

examples.en: Grocery chains live on a merchandise stock turnover ratio far above the norm.
examples.zh: 食品连锁店靠远高于常值的「商品存货周转率」生存。

collocations: calculate the merchandise stock turnover ratio
compare the merchandise stock turnover ratio
interpret the merchandise stock turnover ratio

words.enDefinition: the cost of non-inventoriable

examples.en: Selling commissions are a non-inventoriable cost, expensed the moment they arise.
examples.zh: 销售佣金属于「不能列入存货的成本」，发生即费用化。

examples.en: Storage for finished goods is a non-inventoriable cost under the standard.
examples.zh: 按准则规定，成品仓储费属于「不能列入存货的成本」。

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in chief

examples.en: The chief accountant signs every payment above five hundred before it leaves.
examples.zh: 超过五百英镑的付款都须经「会计主任」签字后才能发出。

examples.en: Our chief accountant doubles as the tax deadline memory of the firm.
examples.zh: 我们的「会计主任」还兼任全公司的报税日历。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for non-stock

examples.en: A non-stock agent simply forwards orders, never touching the goods.
examples.zh: 「不掌握存货的代理人」只负责转递订单，从不经手货物。

examples.en: As a non-stock agent, she books commission only when the sale completes.
examples.zh: 作为「不掌握存货的代理人」，她只在成交时确认佣金。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to non-revenue

examples.en: Fines and licence fees are non-revenue receipt items, not taxes proper.
examples.zh: 罚款和牌照费属于「非税收收入」项目，并非严格意义的税。

examples.en: The council funds the pool from non-revenue receipt sources like hall hire.
examples.zh: 市政会用场馆出租等「非税收收入」来维持泳池运营。

words.enDefinition: assets associated with non-depreciable

examples.en: Land and paintings stay non-depreciable assets, however old or valuable they become.
examples.zh: 土地和画作无论多老多贵，都是「不计提折旧的资产」。

examples.en: The register flags non-depreciable assets so nobody schedules a pointless charge.
examples.zh: 登记册标出「不计提折旧的资产」，免得有人白提折旧。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in cost of carrying

examples.en: Insurance, cold storage, and spoilage make the cost of carrying inventory brutal.
examples.zh: 保险、冷藏和损耗让「存货保管储存成本」高得吓人。

examples.en: We cut the cost of carrying inventory by ordering fish twice weekly.
examples.zh: 改成每周两次订鱼后，我们的「存货保管储存成本」降了下来。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in cost of acquiring

examples.en: The cost of acquiring inventory includes freight, duties, and unloading labour.
examples.zh: 「存货购入的成本」包含运费、关税和卸货人工。

examples.en: Discounts received shrink the cost of acquiring inventory below list price.
examples.zh: 拿到折扣后，「存货购入的成本」落到了定价之下。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of nominal

examples.en: The duchy pays a nominal tax of one rose per year, by tradition.
examples.zh: 依照传统，公爵领地每年只缴一支玫瑰的「名义上的税收」。

examples.en: A nominal tax of a shilling keeps the charter legally alive.
examples.zh: 一先令的「名义上的税收」让那份特许状在法律上继续有效。

words.enDefinition: keeping for cost

examples.en: Careful cost keeping exposed the packaging line as the real money drain.
examples.zh: 细致的「成本记录」揭露出包装线才是真正的失血点。

examples.en: His cost keeping habits began with a pencil and a shop notebook.
examples.zh: 他的「成本记录」习惯，是从一支铅笔和一本店用笔记簿开始的。

words.enDefinition: auditors independent of the entity being audited

examples.en: Independent auditors confirm the cash straight with the bank each year.
examples.zh: 「独立审计师」每年都直接向银行确认现金余额。

examples.en: Only independent auditors may sign the opinion; the client pays the fee.
examples.zh: 只有「独立审计师」才能签署审计意见，尽管费用由客户支付。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in index of producer's

examples.en: The index of producer's inventory climbed for a third straight month.
examples.zh: 「生产者存货指数」连续第三个月攀升。

examples.en: Economists read the index of producer's inventory as an early demand signal.
examples.zh: 经济学家把「生产者存货指数」视为需求的先行信号。

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in chartered public

examples.en: The chartered public accountant countersigned the trust accounts without a fee.
examples.zh: 那位「注册会计师」免费会签了信托账目。

examples.en: Passing the exams made him a chartered public accountant at twenty-six.
examples.zh: 通过考试后，他二十六岁就成了「注册会计师」。

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in chartered

examples.en: Our chartered accountant warned us about the VAT scheme before we signed.
examples.zh: 还没签字，我们的「执业会计师」就提醒了那套增值税方案的风险。

examples.en: The chartered accountant traced the missing twenty thousand to one dormant account.
examples.zh: 「执业会计师」把失踪的两万英镑追到了一个沉睡账户。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of obsolete held for sale or use

examples.en: Obsolete stock of videotapes finally went to the recycling contractor.
examples.zh: 录像带的「陈旧存货」最终交给了回收承包商。

examples.en: We value obsolete stock at scrap price, which the auditor approved.
examples.zh: 我们的「陈旧存货」按废料价计价，审计师予以认可。

words.enDefinition: the cost of utilization

examples.en: The cost of utilization charges the boiler against every hour it actually runs.
examples.zh: 按「耗用成本」计提，锅炉每运行一小时就摊一笔。

examples.en: Utilities spread the cost of utilization across the departments that actually consume.
examples.zh: 水电费用按实际耗用把「耗用成本」分摊到各部门。

words.enDefinition: accounting for normal cost

examples.en: Normal cost accounting ignores freak spikes and values work at typical rates.
examples.zh: 「正常成本会计」剔除异常波动，按常态费率计价。

examples.en: Under normal cost accounting, the strike week's overtime never touched unit costs.
examples.zh: 在「正常成本会计」下，罢工周的加班费完全不进单位成本。

collocations: roll forward the normal cost accounting

words.enDefinition: indexes concerning inventory-sales

examples.en: The indexes of inventory-sales signalled restocking before any sales report did.
examples.zh: 在任何销售报告之前，「存货销售率指数」就发出了补货信号。

examples.en: Planners watch the indexes of inventory-sales to time the autumn buy.
examples.zh: 企划人员盯着「存货销售率指数」来把握秋季进货节奏。

words.enDefinition: promissory notes receivable from customers

examples.en: Notes receivable from customers mature monthly through the spring season.
examples.zh: 整个春季，「应收客户票据」逐月到期。

examples.en: The dealer financed the tractor with notes receivable from customers, forty-eight months long.
examples.zh: 经销商用长达四十八个月的「应收客户票据」为那台拖拉机融资。

words.enDefinition: notes receivable due from stockholders

examples.en: Notes receivable from stockholders appear separately, never inside trade receivables.
examples.zh: 「应收股东票据」单独列示，绝不混入贸易应收款。

examples.en: Auditors test notes receivable from stockholders for arm's-length interest every year.
examples.zh: 审计员每年都会检验「应收股东票据」是否计收公允利息。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning notes receivable from

examples.en: Notes receivable from trade fill one drawer of the fireproof cabinet.
examples.zh: 防火柜里有一个抽屉专门存放「应收商业票据」。

examples.en: We track notes receivable from trade by maturity, discounting the earliest first.
examples.zh: 我们按到期日管理「应收商业票据」，先贴现最早到期的。

collocations: accrue the notes receivable from trade
restate the notes receivable from trade
roll forward the notes receivable from trade

words.zhGloss: 国民会计师协会（历史名称）
words.enDefinition: historical name (to 1991) of the U.S. professional body now known as the Institute of Management Accountants (IMA)
acceptedZhAnswers: 国民会计师协会（历史名称）

examples.en: The national association of accountants was the body's name until 1991.
examples.zh: 1991 年之前，该组织的名称是「国民会计师协会」。

examples.en: Grandfather's certificate from the national association of accountants still hangs in his study.
examples.zh: 祖父的「国民会计师协会」证书至今还挂在他的书房里。

words.enDefinition: a system for national income accounting

examples.en: The national income accounting system splits output into consumption, investment, and government.
examples.zh: 「国民收入会计制度」把产出分为消费、投资和政府三块。

examples.en: Statisticians rebased the national income accounting system after the border changed.
examples.zh: 边界变更后，统计学家重新设定了「国民收入会计制度」的基期。

collocations: apply the national income accounting system
adopt the national income accounting system
document the national income accounting system

words.enDefinition: accounting for national income

examples.en: National income accounting measures the whole economy, not any single firm.
examples.zh: 「国民收入会计」衡量的是整个经济体，而非某一家企业。

examples.en: The tutor used one bakery to explain national income accounting step by step.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用一家面包店逐步讲清了「国民收入会计」。

words.zhGloss: 跨国会计师事务所(公司)
words.enDefinition: an accounting firm that operates across multiple countries
acceptedZhAnswers: 跨国会计师事务所(公司)

examples.en: The multinational accounting firm flew in a specialist for the share scheme.
examples.zh: 那家「跨国会计师事务所」为股权计划专门空运来一位专家。

examples.en: Working for a multinational accounting firm means your client list spans continents.
examples.zh: 在「跨国会计师事务所」工作，意味着你的客户横跨各大洲。

words.enDefinition: accounting for multinational

examples.en: Multinational accounting must reconcile the parent's framework with each host country's rules.
examples.zh: 「跨国公司会计」必须把母公司框架与各国规则调和一致。

examples.en: Hyperinflationary subsidiaries make multinational accounting a genuinely difficult specialist subject.
examples.zh: 恶性通胀的子公司让「跨国公司会计」成了真正的专业难题。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track cost incurred

examples.en: The cost incurred account grows as the builders submit each monthly valuation.
examples.zh: 施工方每提交一次月度结算，「成本发生账户」就增大一分。

examples.en: Compare the cost incurred account with the contract price to spot overruns early.
examples.zh: 把「成本发生账户」与合同价相比，超支便能及早现形。

words.enDefinition: a system for cost accounting

examples.en: The new cost accounting system traces every hour to a named contract.
examples.zh: 新的「成本会计制度」把每个工时都追溯到具名合同。

examples.en: Without a cost accounting system, quoting jobs was guesswork dressed as arithmetic.
examples.zh: 没有「成本会计制度」，报价不过是披着算术外衣的瞎猜。

collocations: tie out the cost accounting system

words.enDefinition: accepted requirements for cost accounting

examples.en: Government contracts require strict cost accounting standards on every claimed hour.
examples.zh: 政府合同要求对申报的每个工时执行严格的「成本会计标准」。

examples.en: The auditor rejected travel claims that broke the published cost accounting standards.
examples.zh: 审计员驳回了违反已公布「成本会计标准」的差旅报销。

words.enDefinition: a board that oversees cost accounting standards

examples.en: The cost accounting standards board settles disputes over what counts as allowable.
examples.zh: 哪些支出算可列支项，由「成本会计准则委员会」裁定。

examples.en: Contractors quote the cost accounting standards board rulings when clients challenge overheads.
examples.zh: 客户质疑间接费用时，承包商会援引「成本会计准则委员会」的裁定。

collocations: accrue the cost accounting standards board
restate the cost accounting standards board
roll forward the cost accounting standards board

words.enDefinition: procedures used in cost accounting

examples.en: Written cost accounting procedures tell every clerk which form follows which.
examples.zh: 书面的「成本会计程序」告诉每位职员单据的先后顺序。

examples.en: The factory documented its cost accounting procedures before the certification visit.
examples.zh: 认证审核之前，工厂把「成本会计程序」全部落成文件。

words.enDefinition: a fundamental rule applied to cost accounting

examples.en: The matching idea is the cost accounting principle behind every accrual we post.
examples.zh: 配比思想是我们所做每一笔应计背后的「成本会计原则」。

examples.en: Consistency, a core cost accounting principle, stops methods changing mid-year.
examples.zh: 一致性这条核心「成本会计原则」禁止年内更换方法。

collocations: roll forward the cost accounting principle

words.enDefinition: a time span used for cost accounting

examples.en: The cost accounting period for the grant runs October to September.
examples.zh: 该补助金的「成本会计期」为十月到次年九月。

examples.en: Closing the cost accounting period locks the rates for the whole year.
examples.zh: 「成本会计期」一经关闭，全年费率就此锁定。

words.enDefinition: a department for cost accounting

examples.en: The cost accounting department sits between the workshop floor and the finance office.
examples.zh: 「成本会计部门」的位置正好夹在车间与财务室之间。

examples.en: Every Friday the cost accounting department publishes the scrap and rework figures.
examples.zh: 「成本会计部门」每周五发布废品与返工数据。

collocations: roll forward the cost accounting department

words.enDefinition: the measurement and allocation of production costs to individual products

examples.en: Cost accounting by products reveals which of the four sauces actually earns.
examples.zh: 「产品别成本会计」揭示了四种酱料中究竟哪种在赚钱。

examples.en: Under cost accounting by products, each jar carries its own label cost.
examples.zh: 在「产品别成本会计」下，每罐酱料都负担自己的标签成本。

words.enDefinition: cost accounting analysed by cost element

examples.en: Cost accounting by elements splits spend into materials, labour, and expenses.
examples.zh: 「要素别成本会计」把开支拆成材料、人工和费用三项。

examples.en: The report on cost accounting by elements filled exactly one printed page.
examples.zh: 关于「要素别成本会计」的报告正好排满一页。

words.enDefinition: cost accounting analysed by department

examples.en: Cost accounting by departments assigns the kiln's fuel to the ceramics bay.
examples.zh: 「部门别成本会计」把窑炉燃料归到陶瓷工段名下。

examples.en: With cost accounting by departments, the paint shop finally answered for itself.
examples.zh: 实行「部门别成本会计」后，喷漆车间终于开始自担盈亏。

words.enDefinition: a detailed examination of cost accounting

examples.en: Our cost accounting analysis showed packing foam costing more than the product.
examples.zh: 「成本会计分析」显示包装泡沫的成本竟然超过产品本身。

examples.en: Each cost accounting analysis ends with one recommendation, never a list.
examples.zh: 每次「成本会计分析」只给出一条建议，绝不罗列一堆。

collocations: roll forward the cost accounting analysis

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in cost

examples.en: The cost accountant values every returnable crate at forty pence.
examples.zh: 「成本会计员」把每个周转箱估值为四十便士。

examples.en: Our cost accountant argued with the sales director over the quoting sheet.
examples.zh: 我们的「成本会计员」为报价单跟销售总监争了起来。

words.enDefinition: earnings measured after tax

examples.en: Net income after tax reached thirty-one thousand, the best year yet.
examples.zh: 「扣税后净收益」达到三万一千英镑，是开业以来最好的一年。

examples.en: The co-op returns net income after tax to members as an annual rebate.
examples.zh: 合作社把「扣税后净收益」作为年度返利退还给社员。

collocations: record the net income after tax
disclose the net income after tax
reconcile the net income after tax

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for net income before

examples.en: Net income before depreciation shows whether operations cover the cash repayments.
examples.zh: 「折旧前净收益」反映经营所得能否覆盖现金还款。

examples.en: The bank read net income before depreciation, then added back the lease charges.
examples.zh: 银行先看「折旧前净收益」，再把租赁费用加回去。

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for net income after

examples.en: Net income after depreciation fell, even though the machines run newer.
examples.zh: 尽管机器更新了，「折旧后净收益」反而下降了。

examples.en: Lenders prefer net income after depreciation for mature, stable engineering firms.
examples.zh: 对于成熟稳定的工程企业，贷款方更看重「折旧后净收益」。

words.enDefinition: an accounting basis that measures items primarily at historical cost

examples.en: Under the cost basis of accounting, the building stays at its 1998 price.
examples.zh: 按「会计的成本基础」，这栋楼仍按 1998 年的价款列账。

examples.en: The cost basis of accounting ignores what the site would fetch today.
examples.zh: 「会计的成本基础」并不理会这块地今天能卖多少钱。

words.enDefinition: an audit of cost

examples.en: The cost audit questioned why freight doubled on identical consignments.
examples.zh: 「成本审计」质询了相同货物为何运费翻倍。

examples.en: Regulated industries face a statutory cost audit every single year.
examples.zh: 受监管行业每年都要接受法定的「成本审计」。

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track cost center

examples.en: Cost center accounts separate the kitchen from the dining room payroll.
examples.zh: 「成本中心账户」把后厨工资与餐厅前厅工资分开。

examples.en: Each manager signs the monthly cost center accounts for their own unit.
examples.zh: 每位经理都要在自己单元的月度「成本中心账户」上签字。

words.enDefinition: pay for labour related to contract

examples.en: Contract wages for the welders are fixed until the project ends.
examples.zh: 焊工的「合同工资」在项目结束前保持固定。

examples.en: Overtime sits outside the contract wages, billed separately each fortnight.
examples.zh: 加班费不在「合同工资」之内，每两周单独结算。

words.enDefinition: the liability to pay payroll taxes

examples.en: The liability for payroll taxes must clear by the nineteenth of the month.
examples.zh: 「应付工资税」必须在每月十九日前缴清。

examples.en: Late payment turns the liability for payroll taxes into a penalty overnight.
examples.zh: 一旦迟缴，「应付工资税」隔天就变成罚款。

words.enDefinition: a system for computer-based accounting

examples.en: The computer-based accounting system posts every till total automatically overnight.
examples.zh: 「电脑会计系统」每晚自动把各收银机合计过账。

examples.en: The practice migrated its computer-based accounting system during the quiet August week.
examples.zh: 事务所趁八月清淡的一周迁移了「电脑会计系统」。

words.enDefinition: an audit of continuous

examples.en: A continuous audit reviews transactions as they happen, not months later.
examples.zh: 「连续审计」在交易发生时即刻复核，而不是几个月后。

examples.en: The bank asked for a continuous audit after the teller discrepancies surfaced.
examples.zh: 出纳差异曝光后，银行要求实施「连续审计」。

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in junior

examples.en: The junior accountant found the transposed total nobody else could see.
examples.zh: 那个谁也看不出的颠倒总数，被「初级会计员」揪了出来。

examples.en: Our junior accountant studies for her exams on the train each morning.
examples.zh: 我们的「初级会计员」每天早上在火车上备考。

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for contingent

examples.en: Contingent depreciation charges the asset only if the extra shifts materialise.
examples.zh: 只有加班计划真的落实，「或有折旧」才会对资产计提。

examples.en: The textbook treats contingent depreciation as a historical curiosity, not current practice.
examples.zh: 教科书把「或有折旧」当作历史遗物，而非现行做法。

words.enDefinition: accounting for job order cost

examples.en: Job order cost accounting ties every nut and hour to your kitchen refit.
examples.zh: 「分批成本会计」把每颗螺母、每个工时都记到你的厨房改造上。

examples.en: Under job order cost accounting, the boatyard quotes before cutting any timber.
examples.zh: 在「分批成本会计」下，船厂先报价，后动锯。

collocations: accrue the job order cost accounting
restate the job order cost accounting
roll forward the job order cost accounting

words.enDefinition: accounting for job cost

examples.en: Job cost accounting revealed the loft conversions losing money on plaster.
examples.zh: 「分批成本会计」显示阁楼改造都亏在腻子粉上。

examples.en: With job cost accounting, each builder carries a folder of signed job cards.
examples.zh: 实行「分批成本会计」后，每个施工队都带着一夹签收的工单。

words.enDefinition: a manual concerning accounts

examples.en: The manual of accounts defines every code the district offices must use.
examples.zh: 「会计规程」规定了各区办事处必须使用的每一个编码。

examples.en: New starters read the manual of accounts before touching a single voucher.
examples.zh: 新员工读完「会计规程」才有资格碰第一张凭单。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track manufacturing burden

examples.en: Indirect factory costs collect in the manufacturing burden account until allocation.
examples.zh: 工厂间接费用先归集到「制造费用账户」，等待分配。

examples.en: The manufacturing burden account closed to nil once absorption rates applied.
examples.zh: 分配率一应用，「制造费用账户」便结平归零。

words.enDefinition: manufactured inventories used in professional practice

examples.en: Manufactured inventories wait in the finished store until each customer's truck arrives.
examples.zh: 「制成品存货」在成品库等待各位客户的卡车到来。

examples.en: We value manufactured inventories at direct cost plus absorbed factory overhead.
examples.zh: 「制成品存货」按直接成本加上已分配制造费用计价。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for manufacturer's

examples.en: The manufacturer's invoice quotes list prices, minus our standing trade discount.
examples.zh: 「制造厂商发票」按定价开列，再减去我们的固定商业折扣。

examples.en: Customs stamped the manufacturer's invoice before the pallets crossed the border.
examples.zh: 托盘过境之前，海关先在「制造厂商发票」上盖了章。

words.zhGloss: 工资的边际生产率理论
words.enDefinition: marginal productivity of wages used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 工资的边际生产率理论

examples.en: The marginal productivity of wages theory argues pay should track each worker's output.
examples.zh: 「工资的边际生产率理论」主张工资应与每个工人的产出挂钩。

examples.en: Critics say the marginal productivity of wages theory ignores bargaining power entirely.
examples.zh: 批评者认为「工资的边际生产率理论」完全无视谈判力量。

collocations: prioritise the marginal productivity of wages
standardise the marginal productivity of wages
monitor the marginal productivity of wages

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record manufacturing expense

examples.en: The manufacturing expense ledger splits maintenance, power, and supervision by month.
examples.zh: 「制造费用分类账」把维护、电力和主管工资按月分栏。

examples.en: Year-end rates come straight from the totals in the manufacturing expense ledger.
examples.zh: 年末费率直接取自「制造费用分类账」的合计数。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track manufacturing expense

examples.en: Every glue pot and brush belongs in the manufacturing expense account.
examples.zh: 每一罐胶水、每一把刷子都应记入「制造费用账户」。

examples.en: The manufacturing expense account swelled the month the new ovens arrived.
examples.zh: 新烤炉到货的那个月，「制造费用账户」明显膨胀。

words.zhGloss: 已分配制造费用日记帐
words.enDefinition: a journal for manufacturing overhead applied
acceptedZhAnswers: 已分配制造费用日记帐

examples.en: The manufacturing overhead applied journal records the rate multiplied by actual hours.
examples.zh: 「已分配制造费用日记账」记录分配率乘以实际工时的结果。

examples.en: Clerks post the manufacturing overhead applied journal every Friday without fail.
examples.zh: 职员们每周五雷打不动地登记「已分配制造费用日记账」。

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record manufacturing overhead

examples.en: The manufacturing overhead ledger gathers rent, power, and supervisory pay separately.
examples.zh: 「制造费用分类账」把租金、电力和主管工资分项归集。

examples.en: Reconciling the manufacturing overhead ledger against the control account takes minutes now.
examples.zh: 如今把「制造费用分类账」与统制账户核对只需几分钟。

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in management

examples.en: The management accountant turned the depot's losses into a one-page story.
examples.zh: 「管理会计人员」把仓库的亏损写成了一页纸的故事。

examples.en: Our management accountant sits in the Monday pricing meeting, not the archive room.
examples.zh: 我们的「管理会计人员」坐在周一的定价会上，而不是档案室里。

words.enDefinition: problems arising in management accounting

examples.en: Examiners set management accounting problems around one factory and three decisions.
examples.zh: 考官围绕一家工厂、三个决策来编「管理会计问题」。

examples.en: Real management accounting problems rarely arrive as neatly as textbook ones.
examples.zh: 现实中的「管理会计问题」很少像教科书里那样工整。

words.enDefinition: a system for management accounting

examples.en: The management accounting system delivers weekly margin reports to every branch.
examples.zh: 「管理会计制度」每周向各分店送达毛利报告。

examples.en: Their management accounting system failed the day the spreadsheets stopped talking.
examples.zh: 表格之间断了联动的那个月，「管理会计制度」形同虚设。

words.enDefinition: an inventory checker used in professional practice

examples.en: The inventory checker recounts anything whose count differs by more than two.
examples.zh: 凡是清点数差超过两件的，「存货查对员」都要复点。

examples.en: Our inventory checker works with a scanner and a very sharp pencil.
examples.zh: 我们的「存货查对员」工作时带着扫码枪和削得极尖的铅笔。

words.enDefinition: the cost at which inventory is carried, including purchase price and related costs

examples.en: Inventory cost includes the purchase price, freight, and the handling before shelving.
examples.zh: 「存货成本」包括买价、运费和上架前的处理费用。

examples.en: Rising resin prices pushed our inventory cost up by nearly a fifth.
examples.zh: 树脂涨价使我们的「存货成本」抬高了近五分之一。

words.enDefinition: a selection for inventory cost

examples.en: Inventory cost selection between FIFO and average changes the reported margin.
examples.zh: 在先进先出法与平均法之间的「存货成本选择」，会改变报表毛利。

examples.en: The board documents its inventory cost selection in the accounting manual.
examples.zh: 董事会把「存货成本的选择」白纸黑字写进会计手册。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for inventory

examples.en: Inventory costing runs nightly, repricing every line the buyers touched.
examples.zh: 「存货成本计算」每晚运行一遍，采购动过的品项全部重新计价。

examples.en: Careful inventory costing kept the tinned goods from hiding the fresh losses.
examples.zh: 精细的「存货成本计算」让罐头货没法掩盖生鲜的亏损。

words.enDefinition: an inventory costing and control used in professional practice

examples.en: Inventory costing and control pair a monthly count with weekly margin reviews.
examples.zh: 「存货成本计价与控制」把每月盘点与每周毛利复核结合起来。

examples.en: Their inventory costing and control caught the freezer fault within one week.
examples.zh: 靠着「存货成本计价与控制」，冷柜故障一周内就被发现。

words.enDefinition: the cost of inventoriable

examples.en: Direct materials and factory labour are inventoriable cost; selling is not.
examples.zh: 直接材料和工厂人工属于「可列入存货的成本」，销售费用则不然。

examples.en: Freight inward is an inventoriable cost, capitalised into every carton received.
examples.zh: 进货运费属于「可列入存货的成本」，资本化进每个纸箱。

words.enDefinition: accounting for managerial

examples.en: Managerial accounting answers the kitchen's question: which dishes actually make money?
examples.zh: 「管理会计」回答了后厨的问题：究竟哪些菜在赚钱？

examples.en: Unlike financial reporting, managerial accounting can use made-up units like covers per hour.
examples.zh: 与财务报告不同，「管理会计」可以用每小时客数这种自定义单位。

words.enDefinition: auditing of managerial

examples.en: Managerial auditing reviews decisions and controls, not just the ledger balances.
examples.zh: 「管理审计」审查的是决策与控制，而不只是账面余额。

examples.en: The group ordered managerial auditing after two depots bought identical freezers.
examples.zh: 两个仓库买了同样的冷柜之后，集团下令进行「管理审计」。

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in managerial

examples.en: The managerial accountant prices each catering job before the sales team calls.
examples.zh: 「管理会计人员」赶在销售团队致电之前就把每单餐饮业务定价。

examples.en: As a managerial accountant, she never touches the statutory filing at all.
examples.zh: 作为「管理会计人员」，她完全不碰法定申报那一摊。

words.enDefinition: accounting for management through

examples.en: Management through accounting means steering the crew by numbers they can check.
examples.zh: 「会计管理」就是用船员们能核对的数据来掌舵。

examples.en: The yard practises management through accounting, posting weekly idle-hour charts.
examples.zh: 船厂推行「会计管理」，每周张贴停工工时图表。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track commission

examples.en: The commission account collects every fee the letting agents charge us.
examples.zh: 「手续费账户」归集房产中介向我们收取的每一笔佣金。

examples.en: Audit the commission account against the agency statements before renewing the contract.
examples.zh: 续约之前，先把「手续费账户」与中介对账单核对一遍。

words.enDefinition: officials appointed to examine and report on public or organisational accounts

examples.en: The commissioners of audit publish their findings on the county accounts each autumn.
examples.zh: 「审计委员」每年秋天公布对郡账目的审查结果。

examples.en: Two commissioners of audit attended the closing of the parish books.
examples.zh: 两位「审计专员」到场监督了教区账目的年终结算。

words.enDefinition: a commissioner concerning customs

examples.en: The commissioner of customs signed the new bonded warehouse licence personally.
examples.zh: 「海关税务司」亲自签发了新的保税仓库执照。

examples.en: Importers appeal duty rulings straight to the commissioner of customs.
examples.zh: 进口商对关税裁定不服，可直接向「海关税务司」申诉。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track commission receivable

examples.en: The commission receivable account grows with every policy the broker writes.
examples.zh: 经纪人每签一张保单，「应收手续费账户」就增大一分。

examples.en: We clear the commission receivable account the day the insurer remits.
examples.zh: 保险公司汇款当天，我们就结清「应收手续费账户」。

collocations: roll forward the commission receivable account

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of commission

examples.en: Commission receivable from the January listings still totals nine thousand.
examples.zh: 一月挂牌业务产生的「应收手续费」仍有九千英镑未收。

examples.en: Chase commission receivable weekly, or the agents simply forget to pay.
examples.zh: 「应收手续费」要每周催，否则中介们就会忘得一干二净。

words.enDefinition: a voucher supporting commercial

examples.en: Each commercial voucher carries the buyer's stamp before it reaches the ledger.
examples.zh: 每张「商业传票」都要先盖买方印章，然后才能入账。

examples.en: The archive keeps every commercial voucher for the statutory seven years.
examples.zh: 档案室按规定把每张「商业传票」保存七年。

words.enDefinition: auditing of compliance

examples.en: Compliance auditing checks whether staff followed the rules, not whether profit grew.
examples.zh: 「符合审计」检查的是员工是否守规，而不是利润有没有增长。

examples.en: The grant conditions require annual compliance auditing by someone independent.
examples.zh: 补助金条款要求由独立人士每年执行「符合审计」。

words.enDefinition: a form used for invoice approval

examples.en: No invoice pays without a signed invoice approval form attached underneath.
examples.zh: 没有签署的「购货发票核准支付单」随附，任何发票都不得付款。

examples.en: The invoice approval form records who checked the goods and when.
examples.zh: 「购货发票核准支付单」载明验货人及验货时间。

collocations: roll forward the invoice approval form

words.enDefinition: a book recording inward invoices

examples.en: The invoice book inward lists every consignment we bought from abroad.
examples.zh: 「进口发票簿」逐笔登记我们从海外购进的每批货物。

examples.en: Customs officers compared the invoice book inward with the manifest for March.
examples.zh: 海关关员把三月的「进口发票簿」与舱单逐一比对。

collocations: tie out the invoice book inward

words.enDefinition: a book recording outward invoices

examples.en: The invoice book outward records each shipment we billed last quarter.
examples.zh: 「出口发票簿」记录了上季度我们开票的每批发运货物。

examples.en: Sales totals come straight from the invoice book outward, page by page.
examples.zh: 销售合计直接逐页取自「出口发票簿」。

words.enDefinition: auditing of comprehensive

examples.en: Comprehensive auditing covers finance, operations, and safety in one visit.
examples.zh: 「综合审计」一次进场就把财务、运营和安全全部覆盖。

examples.en: The council commissioned comprehensive auditing after three years of isolated spot checks.
examples.zh: 零敲碎打的抽查持续三年后，市政会改聘「综合审计」。

words.enDefinition: invoice for sales used in professional practice

examples.en: Every invoice for sales quotes our VAT number at the footer.
examples.zh: 每张「销售发票」的页脚都印有我们的增值税号。

examples.en: The customer demands an invoice for sales before the courier even unloads.
examples.zh: 快递员还没卸货，客户就先索要「销售发票」。

collocations: roll forward the invoice for sales

words.enDefinition: the price charged in invoice transactions

examples.en: The invoice price matched the quotation to the penny, which surprised us.
examples.zh: 「发票价格」与报价单分毫不差，让我们颇感意外。

examples.en: Dealers buy each car below invoice price during the plate-change month.
examples.zh: 换牌月份，经销商拿车的「发票价格」能低于开票价。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track inventory suspense

examples.en: Unlabelled pallets went straight into the inventory suspense account until identified.
examples.zh: 没有标签的托盘先记入「存货暂记账户」，查明后再转出。

examples.en: Clear the inventory suspense account fully before the year-end stock valuation.
examples.zh: 年末存货计价之前，必须把「存货暂记账户」彻底清空。

words.enDefinition: a control of inventory used in professional practice

examples.en: Tight control of inventory means nobody signs for goods they did not count.
examples.zh: 严格的「存货控制」意味着没人能为没清点过的货物签收。

examples.en: The audit praised our control of inventory but flagged the unlabelled shelf.
examples.zh: 审计肯定了我们的「存货控制」，只对无标签货架提出警示。

words.enDefinition: a time span used for inventory turnover

examples.en: The inventory turnover period lengthened from six weeks to eleven.
examples.zh: 「存货周转期」从六周拉长到了十一周。

examples.en: A short inventory turnover period frees cash for the next fashion buy.
examples.zh: 「存货周转期」短，现金就能腾出来进下一季的时装。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates inventory turnover

examples.en: The inventory turnover ratio reached nine after the freezer stock cleared.
examples.zh: 冷冻库存清空后，「存货周转率」达到了九次。

examples.en: Compare the inventory turnover ratio with last year before praising the buyer.
examples.zh: 表扬采购之前，先把「存货周转率」与去年比一比。

words.enDefinition: a variation for inventory

examples.en: The monthly inventory variation reflected the school term's food swings.
examples.zh: 月度「存货变动」反映出学期内食堂食材的起伏。

examples.en: Unexplained inventory variation triggered a recount of the whole cold store.
examples.zh: 说不清缘由的「存货变动」引发了对整座冷库的复点。

words.enDefinition: a system for company's accounting

examples.en: The company's accounting system refuses invoices without a purchase order number.
examples.zh: 「公司会计制度」拒绝接受没有采购订单号的发票。

examples.en: Auditors walked through the company's accounting system from dock to dispatch.
examples.zh: 审计员从收货码头一路走到发货区，走查了「公司会计制度」。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track inventory fluctuation

examples.en: The inventory fluctuation account absorbs the swings between cost and replacement value.
examples.zh: 成本与重置价值之间的波动由「存货价格变动账户」吸收。

examples.en: Grain merchants watch the inventory fluctuation account through every harvest season.
examples.zh: 粮商在每个收成季都紧盯「存货价格变动账户」。

words.enDefinition: an audit of complete

examples.en: A complete audit examined every one of the nine thousand vouchers.
examples.zh: 「全部审计」把九千张凭单逐张查了一遍。

examples.en: Regulators ordered a complete audit rather than the usual sampled review.
examples.zh: 监管机构要求进行「全部审计」，而不是惯常的抽样检查。

words.enDefinition: a process method concerning cost-finding

examples.en: Under the process method of cost-finding, each refinery stage carries its own average.
examples.zh: 按「成本会计的分步法」，炼厂每个工序都有自己的平均成本。

examples.en: The process method of cost-finding averages costs across the whole continuous run.
examples.zh: 「成本会计的分步法」把成本在整个连续流程中平均化。

collocations: sample the process method of cost-finding
vouch the process method of cost-finding
tie out the process method of cost-finding

words.enDefinition: accounting for process cost

examples.en: Process cost accounting suits the dairy, where every litre flows through identical stages.
examples.zh: 「分步成本会计」适合乳品厂——每升奶都经过相同的工序。

examples.en: Under process cost accounting, losses in one stage spread across all output.
examples.zh: 在「分步成本会计」下，某一工序的损耗会摊到全部产出。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track production cost

examples.en: The production cost account collects fabric, thread, and cutting-room wages.
examples.zh: 「生产成本账户」归集面料、缝线和裁剪车间工资。

examples.en: Debits to the production cost account paused the week the looms broke.
examples.zh: 织机故障那一周，「生产成本账户」的借方几乎停摆。

collocations: tie out the production cost account

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track producing departmental charges

examples.en: The producing departmental charges account lists each workshop's share of the utilities.
examples.zh: 「生产部门费用账户」逐项列出各车间应承担的水电费。

examples.en: Foremen sign the producing departmental charges account before month-end close.
examples.zh: 月末结账前，各工段长要在「生产部门费用账户」上签字。

words.enDefinition: an audit of private

examples.en: The family trust orders a private audit that never reaches the press.
examples.zh: 家族信托委托的「不公开审计」从不进入媒体视野。

examples.en: A private audit reassures the bank without airing the figures publicly.
examples.zh: 「不公开审计」让银行安心，又不必把数字公之于众。

words.enDefinition: a principle concerning wage-payment

examples.en: The principle of wage-payment here is simple: equal hours, equal pay.
examples.zh: 这里的「工资支付原则」很简单：同工时，同薪酬。

examples.en: Union and management finally agreed the principle of wage-payment for night shifts.
examples.zh: 工会与管理方终于就夜班的「工资支付原则」达成一致。

words.enDefinition: the projected financial position in a budgeted balance sheet

examples.en: The budgeted financial position shows the overdraft shrinking by June.
examples.zh: 「预计资产负债表」显示透支额将在六月前收窄。

examples.en: Lenders compare the budgeted financial position against each quarter's actual figures.
examples.zh: 贷款方逐季度把「预计资产负债表」与实际数字对照。

words.enDefinition: statements of budgeted profit

examples.en: Budgeted profit statements arrive each January, one for every department.
examples.zh: 「预算利润表」每年一月送达，每个部门一份。

examples.en: Compare budgeted profit statements with the actuals before praising anyone.
examples.zh: 表扬任何人之前，先把「预算利润表」与实际数比一比。

words.enDefinition: import duties set high enough to discourage imports

examples.en: Prohibitive import duties on cheese make smuggling almost profitable, sadly.
examples.zh: 令人遗憾的是，奶酪的「抑制进口关税」高得让走私几乎有利可图。

examples.en: The government set prohibitive import duties to protect the tiny wool industry.
examples.zh: 政府开征「抑制进口关税」，以保护弱小的羊毛产业。

words.enDefinition: an audit of project

examples.en: The project audit questioned why the bridge budget doubled twice.
examples.zh: 「项目审计」质询了桥梁预算为何翻了两番。

examples.en: Every project audit ends with lessons, not just a verdict.
examples.zh: 每次「项目审计」除了结论，还要沉淀经验教训。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for customs

examples.en: The customs invoice names the origin country beside every line item.
examples.zh: 「海关发票」在每个品目旁都注明原产国。

examples.en: Without the customs invoice, the shipment idled two weeks at the border.
examples.zh: 缺了「海关发票」，货物在边境滞留了两周。

words.enDefinition: accounting for budgetary

examples.en: Budgetary accounting tracks each appropriation against actual spending, vote by vote.
examples.zh: 「预算会计」按表决项目逐项对照拨款与实际支出。

examples.en: Councils practise budgetary accounting because overspending a vote is illegal.
examples.zh: 市政会之所以实行「预算会计」，是因为超出表决额度即属违法。

words.enDefinition: a depot where goods are held free of customs duty

examples.en: The customs free depot lets us re-export watches without paying duty.
examples.zh: 有了「海关免税仓库」，我们转口手表无须缴税。

examples.en: Goods sit in the customs free depot until the buyer arranges collection.
examples.zh: 货物存于「海关免税仓库」，等买家安排提货。

words.enDefinition: a tariff applied to customs import

examples.en: The customs import tariff lists every classification with its exact duty rate.
examples.zh: 「海关进口税则」逐项列明每种归类及其准确税率。

examples.en: Lawyers argued over which heading the customs import tariff assigned our pumps.
examples.zh: 律师们争论「海关进口税则」把我们的泵归到了哪个税号。

collocations: comply with the customs import tariff

words.enDefinition: accounting for productivity

examples.en: Productivity accounting measures output per pound of payroll, not profit alone.
examples.zh: 「生产率会计」衡量的是每英镑工资的产出，而不只是利润。

examples.en: The plant credited productivity accounting with exposing the slow third shift.
examples.zh: 工厂把暴露第三班低效归功于「生产率会计」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for production unit

examples.en: Production unit accounting tracks each assembly hall as its own small business.
examples.zh: 「生产单位会计」把每座装配车间当作一家小企业来核算。

examples.en: Under production unit accounting, hall four's heating bill belongs to hall four.
examples.zh: 在「生产单位会计」下，四号车间的取暖费就得记在四号车间头上。

words.zhGloss: 把出口销售金额过入总帐
words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to post up export
acceptedZhAnswers: 把出口销售金额过入总帐

examples.en: Every Friday I post up export sales in the general ledger by destination.
examples.zh: 每周五我都按目的地把出口销售金额「过入总账」。

examples.en: Please post up export sales before the auditor arrives, not after.
examples.zh: 请赶在审计师进场之前把出口销售金额「过入总账」，别拖到之后。

words.enDefinition: accounting for current cost

examples.en: Current cost accounting values the fleet at today's replacement prices.
examples.zh: 「现行成本会计」按今天的重置价格对车队计价。
