examples.en: Under current cost accounting, holding gains appear separately from trading profit.
examples.zh: 在「现行成本会计」下，持有收益与经营利润分开列示。

collocations: roll forward the current cost accounting

words.enDefinition: accounting for business

examples.en: Business accounting for the corner shop fits on a single ledger pad.
examples.zh: 街角小店的「商业会计」一本账簿就够了。

examples.en: Her evening class in business accounting filled with market traders every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，她的「商业会计」夜校班都坐满集市商贩。

words.enDefinition: accountancy applied to business enterprises

examples.en: Business accountancy was the only module he passed with distinction.
examples.zh: 「商业会计学」是他唯一拿到优等的课程。

examples.en: The diploma in business accountancy takes two evenings a week for a year.
examples.zh: 「商业会计学」文凭课程每周上两个晚上，为期一年。

words.enDefinition: an audit of business

examples.en: The buyer's business audit examined our customer list more than our books.
examples.zh: 买方进行的「企业审计」，重点查的竟是我们的客户名单而非账簿。

examples.en: A thorough business audit before acquisition beats any glossy sales brochure.
examples.zh: 收购之前做一次彻底的「企业审计」，胜过任何精美的宣传册。

words.enDefinition: money received from pretax accounting

examples.en: Pretax accounting income rose, though the tax charge swallowed most of it.
examples.zh: 「未扣税金的账面收益」上升了，只是税负吞掉了大半。

examples.en: Compare pretax accounting income between the two shops before judging the manager.
examples.zh: 评价店长之前，先比较两家店的「未扣税金的账面收益」。

words.enDefinition: price at duty that has been paid

examples.en: Quote the price at duty paid, so the customer never sees customs paperwork.
examples.zh: 报价按「付关税的价格」，客户完全不必接触海关单证。

examples.en: The catalogue lists each camera at a price at duty paid.
examples.zh: 目录上每台相机都标注「付关税的价格」。

collocations: record the price at duty paid
disclose the price at duty paid
reconcile the price at duty paid

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of premium on bond

examples.en: The premium on bond payable amortises down over the loan's full life.
examples.zh: 「应付公司债溢价」在债券整个存续期内逐期摊减。

examples.en: Interest expense shrinks because the premium on bond payable offsets the coupon.
examples.zh: 由于「应付公司债溢价」抵减票息，利息费用随之缩小。

collocations: accrue the premium on bond payable
restate the premium on bond payable
roll forward the premium on bond payable

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of premium on bonds

examples.en: We issued above par, creating a premium on bonds payable of sixty thousand.
examples.zh: 我们溢价发债，形成了六万英镑的「应付公司债溢价」。

examples.en: The premium on bonds payable sits as a credit beside the principal.
examples.zh: 「应付公司债溢价」作为贷方余额列在本金旁边。

collocations: accrue the premium on bonds payable
restate the premium on bonds payable
roll forward the premium on bonds payable

words.enDefinition: a recapture of depreciation used in professional practice

examples.en: Selling the machine early triggered recapture of depreciation on the tax return.
examples.zh: 提前出售机器，纳税申报表上触发了「折旧的再获得」。

examples.en: The recapture of depreciation rule claws back allowances when proceeds exceed book value.
examples.zh: 一旦变卖所得超过账面价值，「折旧的再获得」规则就会追回已享优惠。

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for realized

examples.en: Realized depreciation shows up as cash kept back for eventual replacement.
examples.zh: 「已实现折旧」表现为为最终更换设备而留存下来的现金。

examples.en: The fund treats realized depreciation as a charge against each season's earnings.
examples.zh: 该基金把「已实现折旧」作为对每季盈利的扣减。

words.enDefinition: a rate concerning stock turnover

examples.en: The rate of stock turnover fell to four after the warehouse over-bought.
examples.zh: 仓库超量采购后，「存货周转率」跌到了四次。

examples.en: Fishmongers need a rate of stock turnover measured in days, not months.
examples.zh: 鱼贩的「存货周转率」得按天算，绝不能按月。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of bonds

examples.en: Bonds payable of two million mature in five equal annual instalments.
examples.zh: 两百万英镑的「应付公司债」分五年等额偿还。

examples.en: The notes to bonds payable disclose the coupon and the redemption dates.
examples.zh: 「应付公司债」附注披露了票面利率和赎回日期。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of bonuses

examples.en: Bonuses payable appear as a liability the moment targets are confirmed.
examples.zh: 目标一经确认，「应付奖金」立即确认为一项负债。

examples.en: The scheme caps bonuses payable at eight percent of departmental profit.
examples.zh: 方案规定「应付奖金」上限为部门利润的百分之八。

words.enDefinition: turnover arising from receivable

examples.en: Receivable turnover slowed to five once the big wholesaler started stalling.
examples.zh: 大批发商开始拖延后，「应收款周转率」放慢到五次。

examples.en: We watch receivable turnover weekly, chasing anything past forty-five days.
examples.zh: 我们每周盯「应收款周转率」，超过四十五天的账款一律催收。

words.enDefinition: a time span used for receivables turnover

examples.en: The receivables turnover period stretched to seventy days over the summer.
examples.zh: 整个夏天，「应收账款周转期」拖长到了七十天。

examples.en: A shrinking receivables turnover period means the credit team is winning.
examples.zh: 「应收账款周转期」缩短，说明信用团队正在赢。

collocations: roll forward the receivables turnover period

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates receivables turnover

examples.en: The receivables turnover ratio doubled after we invoiced on delivery day.
examples.zh: 改为发货当天开票后，「应收款周转率」翻了一倍。

examples.en: Analysts read the receivables turnover ratio as a proxy for collection discipline.
examples.zh: 分析师把「应收款周转率」当作催收纪律的代用指标。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in reconciling

examples.en: Reconciling inventory took a day, mostly over the missing blue crates.
examples.zh: 「调节存货」花了一整天，主要卡在那几个失踪的蓝箱子上。

examples.en: Reconciling inventory between the two systems found eleven duplicated pallet labels.
examples.zh: 对两套系统「调节存货」时，发现了十一个重复的托盘标签。

words.enDefinition: accounting for budget

examples.en: Budget accounting keeps the playground fund inside its council-approved limits.
examples.zh: 靠「预算会计」，游乐场基金始终不越市政会批准的额度。

examples.en: The charity switched to budget accounting so restricted gifts stay separate.
examples.zh: 慈善机构改用「预算会计」，让限定用途的捐款单独管理。

words.enDefinition: an audit of public

examples.en: The public audit of the housing association made the local paper.
examples.zh: 对住房协会的「公开审计」登上了地方报纸。

examples.en: A public audit lets every ratepayer read exactly where the money went.
examples.zh: 「公开审计」让每位纳税人都能看清钱的去向。

words.enDefinition: accounting for public

examples.en: Public accounting serves clients across industries rather than one employer.
examples.zh: 「公共会计」服务各行各业客户，而不是单一雇主。

examples.en: She left public accounting for industry, chasing steadier hours at last.
examples.zh: 她终于离开「公共会计」转投企业，只为更规律的作息。

words.enDefinition: a tariff applied to customs

examples.en: The customs tariff assigns wool yarn a lower rate than cloth.
examples.zh: 「关税率」给羊毛纱的定级低于成品布。

examples.en: Negotiators trimmed the customs tariff on machinery before the treaty signed.
examples.zh: 条约签署之前，谈判代表先下调了机械产品的「关税率」。

words.enDefinition: amounts billed for gross amortization

examples.en: Gross amortization charges appear before any grants offset them in the note.
examples.zh: 附注中先列「总摊销费用」，补助冲减之后才见净额。

examples.en: The group's gross amortization charges doubled after the software consolidation.
examples.zh: 软件业务并入之后，集团的「总摊销费用」翻了一倍。

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for group

examples.en: Group depreciation averages the whole van fleet on one blended rate.
examples.zh: 「分组折旧」对整个货车队用一个混合费率计提。

examples.en: Under group depreciation, selling one van barely disturbs the annual charge.
examples.zh: 在「分组折旧」下，卖掉一辆车对年折旧几乎毫无影响。

words.enDefinition: accounting for quality

examples.en: Quality accounting tracks rework hours beside every production line's output.
examples.zh: 「质量会计」把返工工时逐条记录在各产线产出旁。

examples.en: The plant adopted quality accounting after warranty claims tripled in a year.
examples.zh: 质保索赔一年翻了三倍后，工厂引入了「质量会计」。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用成本差异帐户(科目)
words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track cost variance-overhead
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用成本差异帐户(科目)

examples.en: The cost variance-overhead account holds every under- and over-absorption for the quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度所有分配不足与超额都挂在「间接费用成本差异账户」里。

examples.en: Bookkeepers close the cost variance-overhead account straight into cost of sales.
examples.zh: 簿记员把「间接费用成本差异账户」直接结转进销售成本。

collocations: roll forward the cost variance-overhead account

words.zhGloss: 以成本为根据的转帐价格
words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for cost-based transfer
acceptedZhAnswers: 以成本为根据的转帐价格

examples.en: The cost-based transfer price charges the sister plant at full absorbed cost.
examples.zh: 「以成本为根据的转账价格」按完全分配成本向兄弟工厂收费。

examples.en: Tax inspectors prefer a cost-based transfer price because it is easy to verify.
examples.zh: 税务稽查员偏爱「以成本为根据的转账价格」，因为它便于核查。

words.enDefinition: income remaining after tax

examples.en: Income after taxes funded the second kiln without any borrowing.
examples.zh: 靠「税后利润」，第二座窑炉没有借一分钱就建成了。

examples.en: Compare income after taxes across the three plants, not just revenue.
examples.zh: 三座工厂之间要比「税后利润」，别只比收入。

words.enDefinition: an audit of income

examples.en: The income audit traced every booking fee back to its contract.
examples.zh: 「收益审计」把每笔订位费都追溯到了对应合同。

examples.en: Hotel groups run an income audit before franchising any new property.
examples.zh: 连锁酒店在特许任何新物业之前，都会先做「收益审计」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of cost

examples.en: The cost transfer moved the paint overrun to the design department.
examples.zh: 通过「成本转账」，喷漆超支被划归设计部门承担。

examples.en: Every cost transfer needs both managers' signatures before the ledger moves.
examples.zh: 每笔「成本转账」都要两位经理签字，账才能动。

words.enDefinition: a memo recording import duty

examples.en: The import duty memo accompanies every consignment the broker clears.
examples.zh: 报关行放行的每批货物都随附「海关进口税缴纳证」。

examples.en: Attach the import duty memo to the claim, or the insurer queries it.
examples.zh: 索赔时要附上「海关进口税缴纳证」，否则保险公司会来追问。

words.enDefinition: a voucher supporting cash-receipt

examples.en: Every till payment generates a cash-receipt voucher numbered in sequence.
examples.zh: 收银台的每笔收款都会生成连续编号的「现金收入凭证」。

examples.en: The auditor traced one cash-receipt voucher from the drawer to the ledger.
examples.zh: 审计员把一张「现金收入凭证」从抽屉一路追到分类账。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for cash sale

examples.en: The cash sale invoice prints before the drawer even opens.
examples.zh: 钱箱还没弹开，「现售发票」就先打出来了。

examples.en: Keep every cash sale invoice; the VAT inspection counts them against the till.
examples.zh: 每张「现售发票」都要留存，增值税检查会拿它对收银记录。

collocations: tie out the cash sale invoice

words.enDefinition: conditions that govern in bond

examples.en: Under in bond terms, duty falls due only when goods leave the warehouse.
examples.zh: 按「保税仓库交货条件」，关税只在货物出仓时才到期。

examples.en: We quoted in bond terms so the buyer controls the timing of duty.
examples.zh: 我们按「保税仓库交货条件」报价，让买方自行掌握缴税时机。

words.enDefinition: goods held in a bonded warehouse pending customs clearance and duty payment

examples.en: The wine stays in bond until the excise stamps are paid.
examples.zh: 这些葡萄酒「在保税仓库中」存放，直到消费税缴清。

examples.en: Collectors often buy whisky in bond, saving duty for later decades.
examples.zh: 藏家常趁酒「在保税仓库中」时买入，把税款留到几十年后再缴。

words.enDefinition: the foundation used to measure on a cash-on-invoice

examples.en: The new supplier trades only on a cash-on-invoice basis, no credit.
examples.zh: 新供应商只做「按发票现金付款方式」的生意，不给账期。

examples.en: We agreed on a cash-on-invoice basis until the first three orders clear.
examples.zh: 头三笔订单结清之前，双方商定按「按发票现金付款方式」合作。

collocations: accrue the on a cash-on-invoice basis
restate the on a cash-on-invoice basis
roll forward the on a cash-on-invoice basis

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for official

examples.en: The customs desk needs an official invoice, not a pro forma.
examples.zh: 海关窗口只认「正式发票」，形式发票一律不行。

examples.en: Request the official invoice the day the deposit clears, never later.
examples.zh: 定金到账当天就索取「正式发票」，绝不要拖。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in optimal

examples.en: Two weeks of cover is the optimal inventory for our perishable lines.
examples.zh: 对易腐产品线来说，两周备货就是「最理想的存货量」。

examples.en: The model recalculates optimal inventory whenever freight rates move a cent.
examples.zh: 运价每变动一分钱，模型就重算一次「最理想的存货量」。

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in certified public

examples.en: Our certified public accountant files the federal return before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们的「执业会计师」赶在截止日前提交了联邦申报表。

examples.en: A certified public accountant reviewed the charity's books free of charge.
examples.zh: 一位「执业会计师」免费审阅了慈善机构的账簿。

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in certified management

examples.en: As a certified management accountant, she prices every catering contract herself.
examples.zh: 作为「执业管理会计师」，每份餐饮合同都由她亲自定价。

examples.en: The factory hired a certified management accountant before the second shift started.
examples.zh: 二班开工之前，工厂先请来了一位「执业管理会计师」。

words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in certified

examples.en: Our certified accountant signs the year-end statements without any partner review.
examples.zh: 我们的「会计师」无需合伙人复核即可签署年度报表。

examples.en: The certified accountant spotted the duplicated supplier before the bank did.
examples.zh: 「会计师」比银行先一步发现了重复入账的供应商。

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for income offset by

examples.en: Income offset by depreciation left the cash position far healthier than profits suggested.
examples.zh: 「以折旧扣减的收益」背后，现金状况远比利润表显示的稳健。

examples.en: Tax planners like income offset by depreciation because the cash never leaves.
examples.zh: 税务筹划者青睐「以折旧扣减的收益」，因为现金并未流出。

words.enDefinition: an audit of income statement

examples.en: The income statement audit concentrated on cut-off around the year end.
examples.zh: 「收益表审计」把重点放在年末前后的截止测试上。

examples.en: During the income statement audit, two December invoices moved into January.
examples.zh: 「收益表审计」期间，两张十二月发票被调整到了一月。

collocations: tie out the income statement audit

words.enDefinition: accounting for historical cost

examples.en: Historical cost accounting keeps the 1970s warehouse at its purchase price.
examples.zh: 在「历史成本会计」下，七十年代的仓库仍按购入价列账。

examples.en: Critics argue historical cost accounting hides what assets would fetch today.
examples.zh: 批评者认为「历史成本会计」掩盖了资产当前的真实身价。

words.enDefinition: accounting for critical path

examples.en: Critical path accounting charges delay costs to whichever task blocks the schedule.
examples.zh: 「关键路径法会计」把延误成本记到堵塞进度的那项任务头上。

examples.en: The builder uses critical path accounting to price every fortnight of slippage.
examples.zh: 建筑商用「关键路径法会计」给每两周的工期延误定价。

words.enDefinition: an audit of horizontal

examples.en: A horizontal audit follows one invoice type across every department it touches.
examples.zh: 「横向审计」追踪同一类发票流经的每个部门。

examples.en: The horizontal audit exposed three desks approving the same expense twice.
examples.zh: 「横向审计」揪出了三个岗位对同一笔费用的重复审批。

words.enDefinition: accounting for partnership

examples.en: Partnership accounting splits the year's profit along the agreed sharing ratios.
examples.zh: 「合伙会计」按约定的分配比例切分年度利润。

examples.en: Under partnership accounting, each partner's capital account moves with every drawing.
examples.zh: 在「合伙会计」下，每次提取款项都会变动合伙人的资本账户。

words.enDefinition: amounts billed for period depreciation

examples.en: Period depreciation charges fell after two presses left the depreciation schedule.
examples.zh: 两台压机移出折旧表后，「当期折旧费」随之下降。

examples.en: The board reviews period depreciation charges against the maintenance budget each quarter.
examples.zh: 董事会每季度都把「当期折旧费」与维护预算对照审视。

words.enDefinition: an order related to payment

examples.en: The payment order reaches the bank two days before the due date.
examples.zh: 「付款通知」在到期日前两天送达银行。

examples.en: Cancel the payment order immediately; the invoice turned out duplicated.
examples.zh: 那张发票原来是重复的，请立即撤销「付款通知」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for payroll

examples.en: Payroll accounting splits every wage into gross, deductions, and net columns.
examples.zh: 「工资会计」把每笔工资拆成总额、扣款和实发三栏。

examples.en: The outsourced payroll accounting provider runs on our fortnightly hours file.
examples.zh: 外包的「工资会计」服务按我们两周一次的工时表运行。

words.enDefinition: an audit of payroll

examples.en: The payroll audit matched every payslip against the signed clock cards.
examples.zh: 「工资审计」把每张工资单与签名的打卡记录逐一核对。

examples.en: A payroll audit found one leaver still collecting wages in April.
examples.zh: 「工资审计」发现一名离职者四月还在领薪。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track payroll clearing

examples.en: The payroll clearing account empties the day every net payment lands.
examples.zh: 所有实发工资到账之日，「工资结算账户」随即清零。

examples.en: Anything left in the payroll clearing account by Friday gets investigated.
examples.zh: 周五「工资结算账户」若仍有余额，一律查明原因。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for payroll

examples.en: Payroll costs rose faster than the covers we served this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度「工资成本」的涨幅超过了接待客数的涨幅。

examples.en: The quote separates payroll costs from materials so the client sees both.
examples.zh: 报价单把「工资成本」与材料分开列示，客户一目了然。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning payroll

examples.en: The payroll credit lands in every account by seven on payday.
examples.zh: 发薪日早上七点前，「工资转账」就会到每个人的账户。

examples.en: One payroll credit bounced because the leaver had closed her account.
examples.zh: 有一笔「工资转账」被退回，因为离职员工早已销户。

words.enDefinition: a clerk responsible for payroll

examples.en: The payroll clerk checks every starter's right-to-work file before the first run.
examples.zh: 第一次发薪之前，「工资结算员」要核验每位新员工的工作许可档案。

examples.en: Our payroll clerk caught the duplicated overtime the software had approved.
examples.zh: 软件批准的重复加班费，被我们的「工资结算员」拦了下来。

words.enDefinition: a payment of payroll used in professional practice

examples.en: Payment of payroll happens on the twenty-eighth, bank holidays included.
examples.zh: 「工资的支付」定在每月二十八日，节假日也不例外。

examples.en: Direct payment of payroll ended the long queue at the cashier's window.
examples.zh: 「工资的支付」改由银行直发后，出纳窗口前的长队消失了。

words.enDefinition: a payment on a receipt used in professional practice

examples.en: The courier works on payment on a receipt: cash or card at the door.
examples.zh: 这家快递实行「凭收据付款」：上门时现金或刷卡皆可。

examples.en: Payment on a receipt suits our overseas buyers who distrust open credit.
examples.zh: 「凭收据付款」很适合不信任赊账的海外买家。

collocations: sample the payment on a receipt
vouch the payment on a receipt
tie out the payment on a receipt

words.enDefinition: a scale of pay rates used for payroll

examples.en: The payroll scale fixes seven grades from apprentice to shift manager.
examples.zh: 「工资等级表」从学徒到值班经理共分七级。

examples.en: Every October the payroll scale moves with the agreed inflation figure.
examples.zh: 每年十月，「工资等级表」按约定的通胀数字上调。

words.enDefinition: a requisition for payroll

examples.en: The payroll requisition goes to the treasurer once the hours are signed.
examples.zh: 工时签核完成后，「请发工资单」随即送交司库。

examples.en: One missing payroll requisition delayed the whole site's wages by two days.
examples.zh: 一张「请发工资单」的遗失，让全工地工资迟发了两天。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for payroll department

examples.en: Payroll department expenses cover the software licence and the compliance training.
examples.zh: 「工资部门费用」涵盖软件许可和合规培训开支。

examples.en: The outsourced bureau cut our payroll department expenses by nearly half.
examples.zh: 外包代理把我们「工资部门费用」几乎砍掉了一半。

words.enDefinition: a register of payroll

examples.en: The payroll register lists every employee with gross, deductions, and net pay.
examples.zh: 「工资登记簿」逐人列明工资总额、扣款和实发数。

examples.en: Auditors vouch the payroll register against the signed clock cards weekly.
examples.zh: 审计员每周把「工资登记簿」与签名打卡记录核对。

words.enDefinition: payments for payroll

examples.en: Payroll payments leave the dedicated account, never the main current one.
examples.zh: 「工资的付款」只从专用账户流出，绝不动用主要往来账户。

examples.en: The bank flagged two payroll payments sent to the same leaver.
examples.zh: 银行提示有两笔「工资的付款」发给了同一名离职者。

words.enDefinition: a time span used for payroll

examples.en: Our payroll period closes on the fifteenth, whatever the calendar says.
examples.zh: 无论日历怎么排，我们的「工资结算期」一律十五日截止。

examples.en: Overtime worked late in the payroll period lands in the next run.
examples.zh: 「工资结算期」末段的加班费会顺延到下一轮发薪。

words.enDefinition: a balance sheet presenting aggregate

examples.en: The aggregate balance sheet lumps every subsidiary together without eliminations.
examples.zh: 「合并资产负债表」把各子公司简单加总，不作抵销。

examples.en: Analysts prefer the aggregate balance sheet for its raw, unadjusted honesty.
examples.zh: 分析师偏爱「合并资产负债表」那种未经调整的原始坦率。

words.zhGloss: 应收代理商店(客户往来)欠款
words.enDefinition: amounts due from a correspondent bank or firm
acceptedZhAnswers: 应收代理商店(客户往来)欠款

examples.en: Due from correspondent covers the balances our agent bank holds overseas.
examples.zh: 「应收代理行欠款」指我方代理银行在海外持有的往来余额。

examples.en: The due from correspondent account reconciles nightly against the nostro statements.
examples.zh: 「应收代理行欠款」账户每晚与境外代理行对账单核对。

words.enDefinition: a balance sheet presenting amalgamate

examples.en: The amalgamate balance sheet combined the three family firms into one statement.
examples.zh: 「合并资产负债表」把三家家族企业的报表并为一份。

examples.en: Lawyers requested the amalgamate balance sheet before drafting the merger deed.
examples.zh: 起草合并契约之前，律师先索要了「合并资产负债表」。

words.enDefinition: a balance sheet presenting combined

examples.en: The combined balance sheet adds the parent and each associate line by line.
examples.zh: 「合并资产负债表」把母公司与各联营企业逐行相加。

examples.en: Unlike full consolidation, the combined balance sheet keeps intercompany balances visible.
examples.zh: 与全面合并不同，「合并资产负债表」保留公司间余额可见。

words.zhGloss: 客帐(应收帐款)代理到期经营
words.enDefinition: factoring for maturity
acceptedZhAnswers: 客帐(应收帐款)代理到期经营

examples.en: Maturity factoring pays us on each invoice's due date, not at sale.
examples.zh: 「到期保理」在每张发票的到期日付款，而不是在转让当天。

examples.en: Under maturity factoring, the factor still chases the slow payers for us.
examples.zh: 在「到期保理」下，保理商照样替我们催收拖延的付款人。

words.enDefinition: a balance sheet presenting consolidated

examples.en: The consolidated balance sheet eliminates every intercompany balance before totalling.
examples.zh: 「合并资产负债表」在合计之前先抵销全部公司间余额。

examples.en: Goodwill sits as a single line on the consolidated balance sheet.
examples.zh: 「合并资产负债表」上的「商誉」仅以单行列示。

words.enDefinition: dues charged according to custom or usage

examples.en: The port charges customary dues for pilotage and mooring every call.
examples.zh: 每次进港，港口都按惯例收取引航和系缆的「通常的费用」。

examples.en: Customary dues appear on the freight statement as small, recurring lines.
examples.zh: 「通常的费用」在运费单上表现为细小而经常性的条目。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for outstanding

examples.en: Outstanding expenses include the December heating bill nobody had received yet.
examples.zh: 「未付费用」包括谁都没收到的十二月取暖账单。

examples.en: Review outstanding expenses monthly so nothing lands in the wrong period.
examples.zh: 按月复核「未付费用」，免得哪笔账落错了期间。

words.enDefinition: the estimated rental value of owner-occupied property treated as if rent were paid

examples.en: Imputed rent values the shop's own premises as if we paid ourselves.
examples.zh: 「估算租金」把自有店铺按仿佛付给自己租金的方式计价。

examples.en: Economists include imputed rent of owner-occupied homes in the national accounts.
examples.zh: 经济学家把自有住房的「估算租金」也计入国民账户。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to call

examples.en: Each call receipt proves the reminder reached the debtor's registered address.
examples.zh: 每张「催款收据」都能证明催告函送达了债务人的注册地址。

examples.en: The solicitor filed every call receipt before taking the case to court.
examples.zh: 律师在起诉之前，先把每张「催款收据」归档备查。

words.enDefinition: a check issued for wages or salary

examples.en: The pay check still arrives on paper for the two oldest hands.
examples.zh: 两位最资深的老师傅至今仍收纸质「工资支票」。

examples.en: She phoned the bank the morning her pay check failed to clear.
examples.zh: 「工资支票」没能兑付的那个早晨，她立刻给银行打了电话。

words.zhGloss: 资产负债表的分类和估价
words.enDefinition: a balance sheet classification and valuation used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 资产负债表的分类和估价

examples.en: Balance sheet classification and valuation decide what turns current after twelve months.
examples.zh: 「资产负债表的分类和估价」决定了哪些项目满十二个月后转为流动。

examples.en: The lecture on balance sheet classification and valuation uses one fictitious shipyard.
examples.zh: 关于「资产负债表的分类和估价」的讲座以一家虚构船厂为例。

collocations: prioritise the balance sheet classification and valuation
standardise the balance sheet classification and valuation
monitor the balance sheet classification and valuation

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚成本会计员协会
words.enDefinition: an australian institute concerning cost accountants
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚成本会计员协会

examples.en: The australian institute of cost accountants ran its national congress in Adelaide that year.
examples.zh: 「澳大利亚成本会计员协会」那一年在阿德莱德召开了全国大会。

examples.en: Her membership of the australian institute of cost accountants opened doors across Melbourne industry.
examples.zh: 「澳大利亚成本会计员协会」的会员身份让她在墨尔本工业界畅通无阻。

collocations: classify australian institute of cost accountants
measure australian institute of cost accountants
disclose australian institute of cost accountants

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates average accounts receivable turnover

examples.en: The average accounts receivable turnover ratio fell to five after the Christmas credit spree.
examples.zh: 圣诞赊销高峰过后，「应收账款周转率」跌到了五次。

examples.en: Analysts prefer the average accounts receivable turnover ratio because it smooths seasonal spikes.
examples.zh: 分析师偏爱「应收账款周转率」的平均口径，因为它熨平了季节性波动。

collocations: calculate the average accounts receivable turnover ratio
compare the average accounts receivable turnover ratio
interpret the average accounts receivable turnover ratio

words.zhGloss: 工资与价格互为因果的螺旋式上涨
words.enDefinition: a spiral concerning wages and prices
acceptedZhAnswers: 工资与价格互为因果的螺旋式上涨

examples.en: The spiral of wages and prices meant every raise fed straight into next month's menu.
examples.zh: 「工资与价格的螺旋式上涨」意味着每次加薪都直接体现在下个月的菜单上。

examples.en: Governments dread the spiral of wages and prices once it starts feeding itself.
examples.zh: 「工资与价格的螺旋式上涨」一旦开始自我强化，政府便如临大敌。

collocations: calculate the spiral of wages and prices
compare the spiral of wages and prices
reduce the spiral of wages and prices

words.enDefinition: accounting for departmental job order cost

examples.en: Departmental job order cost accounting assigns each repair job to the workshop that touched it.
examples.zh: 「分部分批成本会计」把每个修理工单归到经手的车间名下。

examples.en: With departmental job order cost accounting, the paint bay finally carried its own costs.
examples.zh: 有了「分部分批成本会计」，喷漆工段终于开始负担自己的成本。

collocations: sample the departmental job order cost accounting
vouch the departmental job order cost accounting
tie out the departmental job order cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a reserve set aside for inventory price decline

examples.en: The reserve for inventory price decline covered copper stock bought at the spring peak.
examples.zh: 「存货价格下降准备」覆盖了春季高点买入的铜材库存。

examples.en: Analysts watch the reserve for inventory price decline as a signal of coming write-downs.
examples.zh: 分析师把「存货价格下降准备」视为即将减记的信号。

collocations: classify reserve for inventory price decline
measure reserve for inventory price decline
disclose reserve for inventory price decline

words.zhGloss: 应付帐款供应者帐户借方余额
words.enDefinition: accounts used to track debit balance in supplier's
acceptedZhAnswers: 应付帐款供应者帐户借方余额

examples.en: A debit balance in supplier's accounts usually means we overpaid or returned goods.
examples.zh: 「供应商账户出现借方余额」通常意味着我们多付了款或者退了货。

examples.en: The audit queried every debit balance in supplier's accounts older than sixty days.
examples.zh: 审计对超过六十天的每一笔「供应商账户借方余额」都提出了质询。

words.expression: fully depreciated assets in active use
words.lemma: fully depreciated assets in active use
words.zhGloss: 已提足折旧的在用资产
words.enDefinition: assets still used after being fully depreciated
acceptedZhAnswers: 已提足折旧的在用资产
acceptedEnVariants: fully depreciated assets in active use

examples.en: Fully depreciated assets in active use still appear on the register, just at nil value.
examples.zh: 「已提足折旧的在用资产」仍保留在资产登记册上，只是价值记为零。

examples.en: The forklift is one of the fully depreciated assets in active use, twenty years old.
examples.zh: 那台叉车已用二十年，是「已提足折旧的在用资产」之一。

collocations: classify fully depreciated assets in active use
measure fully depreciated assets in active use
disclose fully depreciated assets in active use

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of turnover ratio of accounts

examples.en: A rising turnover ratio of accounts payable can mean discounts are being missed.
examples.zh: 「应付账款周转率」上升，可能意味着购货折扣正在被白白错过。

examples.en: We track the turnover ratio of accounts payable monthly to guard the cash buffer.
examples.zh: 我们按月跟踪「应付账款周转率」，守护现金缓冲。

collocations: calculate the turnover ratio of accounts payable
compare the turnover ratio of accounts payable
interpret the turnover ratio of accounts payable

words.enDefinition: an account form of balance sheet used in professional practice

examples.en: The account form of balance sheet puts assets on the left, claims on the right.
examples.zh: 「账户式资产负债表」把资产排在左边，权益排在右边。

examples.en: Continental readers recognise the account form of balance sheet from their first textbook.
examples.zh: 欧陆读者从第一本教科书起就熟悉「账户式资产负债表」。

collocations: prioritise the account form of balance sheet
standardise the account form of balance sheet
monitor the account form of balance sheet

words.enDefinition: accounting methods and records for agency and branch

examples.en: Accounting for agency and branch operations keeps head office informed about every consignment.
examples.zh: 「代理商和分支店会计」让总部随时掌握每一批寄售货物。

examples.en: The textbook chapter on accounting for agency and branch uses two shipment examples.
examples.zh: 教科书里「代理商和分支店会计」那一章用了两个发运案例。

collocations: record the accounting for agency and branch
disclose the accounting for agency and branch
reconcile the accounting for agency and branch

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with account payable to affiliated

examples.en: The account payable to affiliated company sits separately from ordinary supplier balances.
examples.zh: 「应付联营公司账款」与普通供应商余额分开列示。

examples.en: Regulators scrutinise any account payable to affiliated company older than the stated terms.
examples.zh: 监管机构会审查任何超出约定账期的「应付联营公司账款」。

collocations: engage the account payable to affiliated company
bank with the account payable to affiliated company
instruct the account payable to affiliated company

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with accounts payable to subsidiary

examples.en: Accounts payable to subsidiary company balances eliminate on consolidation without exception.
examples.zh: 「应付附属公司账款」在合并时一律抵销，毫无例外。

examples.en: We settle accounts payable to subsidiary company monthly, matching the inter-company statement.
examples.zh: 我们按月结清「应付附属公司账款」，并与公司间对账单核对一致。

collocations: open an account at the accounts payable to subsidiary company
deal with the accounts payable to subsidiary company
audit the accounts payable to subsidiary company

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with accounts due from affiliated

examples.en: Accounts due from affiliated company require arm's-length terms, or tax inspectors intervene.
examples.zh: 「应收联营公司账款」必须按公平交易条件签订，否则税务稽查员会介入。

examples.en: The group disclosed accounts due from affiliated company in a dedicated related-party note.
examples.zh: 集团在专门的关联方附注中披露了「应收联营公司账款」。

collocations: record the accounts due from affiliated company
disclose the accounts due from affiliated company
reconcile the accounts due from affiliated company

words.enDefinition: the foundation used to measure accounting on the accrual

examples.en: Accounting on the accrual basis records the sale today, whatever the bank says.
examples.zh: 按「权责发生制」记账，今天成交就今天入账，银行进账与否无关。

examples.en: Small landlords often abandon accounting on the accrual basis for simple cash records.
examples.zh: 小房东常常放弃「权责发生制」，改用简单的现金记录。

collocations: apply the accounting on the accrual basis
adopt the accounting on the accrual basis
document the accounting on the accrual basis

words.enDefinition: money received from accounting for the estate

examples.en: Accounting for the estate income runs until probate finally closes the file.
examples.zh: 「遗产收益会计」要一直做到遗产认证最终结案。

examples.en: Accounting for the estate income separated rent from the cottage and dividend cheques.
examples.zh: 「遗产收益会计」把农舍租金和股利支票分账处理。

collocations: record the accounting for the estate income
disclose the accounting for the estate income
reconcile the accounting for the estate income

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with accounts receivable from subsidiary

examples.en: Accounts receivable from subsidiary company are cross-checked against the parent's matching payable.
examples.zh: 「应收附属公司账款」要与母公司对应的应付项交叉核对。

examples.en: Auditors confirm accounts receivable from subsidiary company with the group's central ledger team.
examples.zh: 审计员与集团的中心账务团队核对确认「应收附属公司账款」。

collocations: sample the accounts receivable from subsidiary company
vouch the accounts receivable from subsidiary company
tie out the accounts receivable from subsidiary company

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to accounts receivable from installment

examples.en: Accounts receivable from installment sales carry interest, unlike ordinary trade balances.
examples.zh: 与普通贸易余额不同，「应收分期付款账款」是带利息的。

examples.en: The furniture shop's accounts receivable from installment sales stretch across three years.
examples.zh: 家具店的「应收分期付款账款」账期横跨三年。

collocations: classify accounts receivable from installment sales
measure accounts receivable from installment sales
disclose accounts receivable from installment sales

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with accounts receivable from affiliated

examples.en: Accounts receivable from affiliated company grew faster than sales, which the board noticed.
examples.zh: 「应收联营公司账款」增速超过销售，董事会注意到了这一点。

examples.en: Transfers settle accounts receivable from affiliated company only after both ledgers agree.
examples.zh: 只有双方账目一致后，划款才能结清「应收联营公司账款」。

collocations: sample the accounts receivable from affiliated company
vouch the accounts receivable from affiliated company
tie out the accounts receivable from affiliated company

words.zhGloss: 制造(间接)费用效率差异帐户
words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track factory expense efficiency variation
acceptedZhAnswers: 制造(间接)费用效率差异帐户

examples.en: Idle minutes feed the factory expense efficiency variation account every single shift.
examples.zh: 每个班次的停机分钟都会汇入「制造费用效率差异账户」。

examples.en: The factory expense efficiency variation account blames maintenance for most of last month's gap.
examples.zh: 「制造费用效率差异账户」把上月大部分差异归咎于设备维护。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates depreciation expense to income

examples.en: A climbing depreciation expense to income ratio signals an ageing, capital-hungry fleet.
examples.zh: 「折旧费对收益比率」不断攀升，说明车队老化、资本投入吃紧。

examples.en: Compare the depreciation expense to income ratio with rivals before judging the margins.
examples.zh: 判断利润率之前，先与同业比较「折旧费对收益比率」。

collocations: calculate the depreciation expense to income ratio

interpret the depreciation expense to income ratio

examples.zh: 按「成本定率折旧法」，压机每年按固定比例计提折旧。

examples.en: The depreciation-fixed percentage of cost method ignores residual value, which purists criticise.
examples.zh: 「成本定率折旧法」不考虑残值，纯粹主义者对此颇有微词。

collocations: accrue the depreciation-fixed percentage of cost method
restate the depreciation-fixed percentage of cost method

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for amortization of other deferred

examples.zh: 「其他递延费用摊销」涵盖分三个赛季支付的模具款。

examples.en: The note reconciles amortization of other deferred expenses with each deferred balance.
examples.zh: 附注把「其他递延费用摊销」与各递延余额逐项调节。

collocations: record the amortization of other deferred expenses
disclose the amortization of other deferred expenses
reconcile the amortization of other deferred expenses

words.enDefinition: a system for installation of a cost

examples.zh: 面包房花了三个月和一位极有耐心的顾问，才完成「成本会计制度的设置」。

examples.en: Installation of a cost system starts with picking cost centres, not with software.
examples.zh: 「成本会计制度的设置」要从选定成本中心开始，而不是先买软件。

collocations: apply the installation of a cost system

document the installation of a cost system

words.zhGloss: 营业外(非营业)收益及费用帐户

acceptedZhAnswers: 营业外(非营业)收益及费用帐户

examples.en: Keep flood damage in the non-operating income and expense accounts, never in gross margin.
examples.zh: 水灾损失记入「营业外收益及费用账户」，绝不能混入毛利。

examples.en: The auditors reclassified two items into non-operating income and expense accounts before signing.
examples.zh: 签字之前，审计员把两个项目重新归入「营业外收益及费用账户」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for process method of cost

examples.en: The process method of cost accounting suits flour milling, where every bag passes identical stages.
examples.zh: 「成本会计的分步法」适合面粉厂——每袋面粉都经过相同的工序。

examples.en: Under the process method of cost accounting, costs average across the whole continuous flow.
examples.zh: 在「成本会计的分步法」下，成本在整个连续流程中平均分摊。

words.zhGloss: 存货计价中的主要成本计算法
words.enDefinition: the process of estimating the worth of prime costing in inventory
acceptedZhAnswers: 存货计价中的主要成本计算法

examples.en: Prime costing in inventory valuation counts only materials and direct labour, leaving overhead out.
examples.zh: 「存货计价中的主要成本计算法」只计材料和直接人工，把间接费用排除在外。

examples.en: Prime costing in inventory valuation understates stock, so year-end margins look worse than reality.
examples.zh: 用「存货计价中的主要成本计算法」会低估存货，年末毛利率显得比实际更差。

collocations: classify prime costing in inventory valuation
measure prime costing in inventory valuation
disclose prime costing in inventory valuation

words.zhGloss: 总店(公司)和分店(公司)帐
words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track head office and branches
acceptedZhAnswers: 总店(公司)和分店(公司)帐

examples.en: The head office and branches account balances every night against the branch's own books.
examples.zh: 「总店和分店账」每晚都要与分店自己的账簿核对平衡。

examples.en: Goods sent north post to the head office and branches account, not to sales.
examples.zh: 发往北边的货物记入「总店和分店账」，而不是记作销售。

words.zhGloss: 应收款项对存货的比率
words.enDefinition: a ratio concerning receivable to inventories
acceptedZhAnswers: 应收款项对存货的比率

examples.en: A rising ratio of receivable to inventories hints at looser credit terms somewhere.
examples.zh: 「应收款项对存货的比率」上升，暗示某处的信用政策放宽了。

examples.en: Compare the ratio of receivable to inventories between the two depots before allocating cash.
examples.zh: 分配资金之前，先比较两个仓库的「应收款项对存货的比率」。

collocations: calculate the ratio of receivable to inventories
compare the ratio of receivable to inventories
interpret the ratio of receivable to inventories

words.zhGloss: 存货对应收款项的比率
words.enDefinition: a ratio concerning inventories to receivables
acceptedZhAnswers: 存货对应收款项的比率

examples.en: The ratio of inventories to receivables rose when the showroom over-ordered garden furniture.
examples.zh: 展厅超量订购园艺家具后，「存货对应收款项的比率」随之上升。

examples.en: A steady ratio of inventories to receivables tells the bank the mix is stable.
examples.zh: 「存货对应收款项的比率」保持平稳，银行便相信资产结构稳定。

collocations: calculate the ratio of inventories to receivables
compare the ratio of inventories to receivables
interpret the ratio of inventories to receivables

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for group system of wage

examples.en: Under the group system of wage payment, the whole crew shares one bonus pot.
examples.zh: 实行「集体支付工资制」后，全班组成员共享一个奖金池。

examples.en: The group system of wage payment ended the quarrels over who had the easier task.
examples.zh: 「集体支付工资制」终结了关于谁干轻活的无休止争吵。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from income taxes on inter-company

examples.en: Income taxes on inter-company profit must wait until the goods reach outside customers.
examples.zh: 「公司之间利润所得税」要等货物卖给外部客户后才产生。

examples.en: The group deferred income taxes on inter-company profit still sitting in closing inventory.
examples.zh: 集团对仍留在期末存货中的公司间利润，递延确认「公司之间利润所得税」。

collocations: prioritise the income taxes on inter-company profit
standardise the income taxes on inter-company profit
monitor the income taxes on inter-company profit

words.zhGloss: 标准(成本)会计部份计划
words.enDefinition: accounting for partial plan of standard
acceptedZhAnswers: 标准(成本)会计部份计划

examples.en: The partial plan of standard accounting applies standards to materials only, nothing else.
examples.zh: 这套「标准会计部分计划」只对材料实行标准成本，其他一概不管。

examples.en: Under the partial plan of standard accounting, labour stayed at actual cost throughout.
examples.zh: 在「标准会计部分计划」下，人工成本全程按实际数计。

collocations: prioritise the partial plan of standard accounting
standardise the partial plan of standard accounting
monitor the partial plan of standard accounting

words.expression: reserve for intra-company profit in inventories
words.lemma: reserve for intra-company profit in inventories
words.zhGloss: 公司内部存货利润准备
words.enDefinition: a reserve set aside for intra-company profit in inventories
acceptedZhAnswers: 公司内部存货利润准备
acceptedEnVariants: reserve for intra-company profit in inventories

examples.en: The reserve for intra-company profit in inventories strips the markup from unsold group stock.
examples.zh: 「公司内部存货利润准备」从集团未售存货中剔除加价部分。

examples.en: Consolidation adjusts the reserve for intra-company profit in inventories every single period.
examples.zh: 合并报表每一期都要调整「公司内部存货利润准备」。

collocations: define “reserve for intra-company profit in inventories”
teach “reserve for intra-company profit in inventories”
revise “reserve for intra-company profit in inventories”

words.zhGloss: 资产负债表项目的分类
words.enDefinition: a classification concerning balance sheet items
acceptedZhAnswers: 资产负债表项目的分类

examples.en: The classification of balance sheet items separates anything due within twelve months.
examples.zh: 「资产负债表项目的分类」把十二个月内到期的项目单独划出。

examples.en: Her essay on the classification of balance sheet items won the faculty prize.
examples.zh: 她那篇关于「资产负债表项目的分类」的论文获得了学院奖。

words.zhGloss: 合并资产负债表工作底稿
words.enDefinition: a balance sheet presenting consolidated balance sheet work
acceptedZhAnswers: 合并资产负债表工作底稿

examples.en: The consolidated balance sheet work sheet lines the parent beside each subsidiary, column by column.
examples.zh: 「合并资产负债表工作底稿」把母公司与各子公司逐栏并列。

examples.en: Eliminations happen on the consolidated balance sheet work sheet before any totals are trusted.
examples.zh: 在采信任何合计数之前，抵销分录都要先在「合并资产负债表工作底稿」上完成。

words.enDefinition: an evasion for tax

examples.en: The builder's tax evasion cost him the licence and nine months of freedom.
examples.zh: 那名建筑商因「偷税漏税」丢了执照，还坐了九个月的牢。

examples.en: Aggressive avoidance is legal advice; tax evasion is a criminal court appearance.
examples.zh: 激进的避税属于合法筹划，「偷税漏税」则要上刑事法庭。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track current

examples.en: The country's current account swung into surplus after the gas exports doubled.
examples.zh: 天然气出口翻番后，该国「经常账」转为顺差。

examples.en: A persistent current account deficit forces the government to borrow abroad each year.
examples.zh: 「经常账」常年逆差，政府只能年年向海外举债。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of sales

examples.en: The register adds sales tax automatically, so cashiers never calculate it by hand.
examples.zh: 收银机自动加算「销货税」，收银员从不需要手工计算。

examples.en: We remit the sales tax quarterly, matched to the till's own totals.
examples.zh: 我们按季度上缴「销货税」，并与收银机的合计数核对一致。

words.enDefinition: a tariff applied to sliding scale

examples.en: The sliding scale tariff moves with the world price of crude.
examples.zh: 「滑动关税」随国际原油价格上下浮动。

examples.en: Under the sliding scale tariff, importers pay less when freight spikes.
examples.zh: 在「滑动关税」下，运费飙升时进口商缴得反而更少。

collocations: comply with the sliding scale tariff

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for formal

examples.en: The finance office accepts only a formal invoice, never a quote.
examples.zh: 财务室只认「正式发票」，报价单一律不收。

examples.en: Print the formal invoice on the numbered stationery the tax office issued.
examples.zh: 「正式发票」必须印在税务局发放的编号票据上。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of short supply of held for sale or use

examples.en: A short supply of stock forced the bakery to close early on Saturday.
examples.zh: 「存货不足」迫使面包店周六提前打烊。

examples.en: The short supply of stock pushed pre-orders into the following month.
examples.zh: 「存货不足」让预售订单顺延到了下个月。

collocations: arrange the short supply of stock
monitor the short supply of stock
repay the short supply of stock

words.enDefinition: a small computer system configured for bookkeeping and accounting tasks (largely historical terminology)

examples.en: The practice's first small accounting computer occupied a corner and groaned audibly.
examples.zh: 事务所第一台「小型会计电脑」占了个墙角，还嗡嗡作响。

examples.en: That small accounting computer stored the whole ledger on cassette tapes.
examples.zh: 那台「小型会计电脑」把整本总账存在盒式磁带里。

words.enDefinition: accounting for forward

examples.en: Forward accounting projects the coming year before anyone commits a budget.
examples.zh: 在任何人敲定预算之前，「预计会计」先把来年测算一遍。

examples.en: The board reads forward accounting scenarios before voting on the expansion.
examples.zh: 表决扩张方案之前，董事会先审阅「预计会计」的多种情景。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to shipping

examples.en: The shipping receipt proves the crates left the yard on Thursday.
examples.zh: 「装货收据」证明板条箱周四就离开了货场。

examples.en: Attach the shipping receipt to the invoice or the customer queries the date.
examples.zh: 发票要随附「装货收据」，否则客户会质疑发货日期。

words.enDefinition: an audit of shop

examples.en: The shop audit found the till two pounds light every Friday.
examples.zh: 「商店审计」发现每周五收银机都短少两英镑。

examples.en: Our shop audit runs quarterly, checking stock against the buying records.
examples.zh: 我们的「商店审计」每季度一次，把库存与进货记录核对。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to shipping parcel

examples.en: The shipping parcel receipt lists each crate's weight and seal number.
examples.zh: 「船运包裹收据」逐件载明板条箱的重量和铅封号。

examples.en: Claims need the shipping parcel receipt, or the insurer delays payment.
examples.zh: 理赔必须出示「船运包裹收据」，否则保险公司会拖付。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of averaging held for sale or use

examples.en: Averaging stock across the year smooths the Christmas and summer peaks.
examples.zh: 全年「计算平均存货」可以熨平圣诞和夏季的峰值。

examples.en: Averaging stock monthly gives a fairer denominator for the turnover ratio.
examples.zh: 按月「计算平均存货」，周转率的分母更公允。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for bad debt

examples.en: Bad debt expense jumped after the garden centre collapsed in June.
examples.zh: 六月园艺中心倒闭后，「呆账费用」猛增。

examples.en: We review bad debt expense quarterly against the ageing schedule.
examples.zh: 我们按季度对照账龄表复核「呆账费用」。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of foreign bills

examples.en: Foreign bills receivable mature in ninety days from the bill of lading.
examples.zh: 「应收国外票据」自提单签发日起九十天到期。

examples.en: We discount foreign bills receivable at the bank when sterling weakens.
examples.zh: 英镑走软时，我们就拿「应收国外票据」去银行贴现。

collocations: tie out the foreign bills receivable

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of foreign bills

examples.en: Foreign bills payable fall due within thirty days of sight.
examples.zh: 「应付国外票据」在见票后三十天内到期。

examples.en: The treasurer funds foreign bills payable the week the dollars arrive.
examples.zh: 美元货款到账那一周，司库就会兑付「应付国外票据」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for single entry

examples.en: Single entry accounting records only one side of each cash movement.
examples.zh: 「单式会计」只记录每笔现金流动的一面。

examples.en: The market stall kept single entry accounting in one battered notebook.
examples.zh: 集市摊位的「单式会计」全靠一本破旧的记事簿。

words.enDefinition: a tariff applied to single-schedule

examples.en: A single-schedule tariff charges every trading partner exactly the same rate.
examples.zh: 「单一制关税率」对所有贸易伙伴一视同仁。

examples.en: The single-schedule tariff removed the preferential deals that favoured two neighbours.
examples.zh: 「单一制关税率」取消了偏袒两个邻国的特惠安排。

words.enDefinition: a balancing an account used in professional practice

examples.en: Balancing an account means drawing the double rule once totals agree.
examples.zh: 「结算账目」就是在合计相符后划上双线结平。

examples.en: Balancing an account each month keeps small errors from snowballing.
examples.zh: 每月「结算账目」，小错就不会越滚越大。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track balance of current

examples.en: The balance of current account swung negative after the fuel imports.
examples.zh: 燃料进口之后，「经常账户结余」转为负数。

examples.en: Remittances lifted the balance of current account for the first time in years.
examples.zh: 侨汇让「经常账户结余」多年来首次转正。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of balance of held for sale or use

examples.en: The balance of stock on the shelf matched the ledger exactly.
examples.zh: 货架上的「存货余额」与账面分毫不差。

examples.en: Write off the balance of stock for the discontinued lines this quarter.
examples.zh: 停产产品线的「存货余额」本季度就要核销。

words.enDefinition: accounting for forestry

examples.en: Forestry accounting treats each stand of timber as a growing asset.
examples.zh: 「林业会计」把每一片林班当作不断生长的资产。

examples.en: Her forestry accounting thesis measured growth rings against recorded cost.
examples.zh: 她的「林业会计」论文把年轮与入账成本对照测算。

words.enDefinition: receivables related to delinquent

examples.en: Delinquent receivables beyond ninety days go straight to the collection agency.
examples.zh: 超过九十天的「拖欠债权」直接移交收账机构。

examples.en: The provision for delinquent receivables doubled after the retailer's receivership.
examples.zh: 零售商进入接管程序后，「拖欠债权」准备金翻倍。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of delinquent

examples.en: The property carries delinquent tax from two years of missed payments.
examples.zh: 这处房产因两年欠缴而背负「滞纳税捐」。

examples.en: Buyers at the tax sale inherit any delinquent tax on the lot.
examples.zh: 税务拍卖的买家会连带承担地块上全部「滞纳税捐」。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track balance

examples.en: The balance account holds the odd difference nobody could trace all year.
examples.zh: 那笔全年查无来龙的零星差额，一直挂在「差额账」里。

examples.en: Clear the balance account before the year-end books are struck.
examples.zh: 年终结账之前，务必把「差额账」清理干净。

words.enDefinition: accounting for standardized

examples.en: Standardized accounting lets the franchisor compare forty outlets on identical forms.
examples.zh: 有了「标准化会计」，特许方可以用统一表格比较四十家门店。

examples.en: The chain enforced standardized accounting before any new franchisee opened.
examples.zh: 任何新加盟商开业之前，连锁总部都强制推行「标准化会计」。

words.enDefinition: an association concerning international accountants

examples.en: The association of international accountants held its congress in Singapore that year.
examples.zh: 那一年，「国际会计师协会」在新加坡召开年会。

examples.en: Her fellowship of the association of international accountants spans four continents.
examples.zh: 她的「国际会计师协会」资深会籍横跨四大洲执业。

words.enDefinition: an association concerning government accountants

examples.en: The association of government accountants runs the municipal certification each spring.
examples.zh: 「政府会计人员联合会」每年春天组织市政会计认证。

examples.en: Her decade in the association of government accountants shaped the county's ledger codes.
examples.zh: 她在「政府会计人员联合会」的十年，重塑了郡里的科目编码。

collocations: prioritise the association of government accountants
standardise the association of government accountants
monitor the association of government accountants

words.enDefinition: an association concerning certified accountants

examples.en: The association of certified accountants examined candidates every June and December.
examples.zh: 「注册会计师协会」每年六月和十二月各举行一次考试。

examples.en: Membership of the association of certified accountants requires three years supervised practice.
examples.zh: 加入「注册会计师协会」须有三年督导下的执业经验。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in finished products

examples.en: Finished products inventory filled the overflow warehouse by late October.
examples.zh: 到十月下旬，「产成品盘存」已经堆满溢库仓库。

examples.en: We value finished products inventory at absorbed cost plus a margin only if earned.
examples.zh: 「产成品盘存」按已分配成本计价，只有利润实现时才含加成。

words.enDefinition: accepted requirements for statement of auditing

examples.en: The statement of auditing standards governs how confirmations must be requested.
examples.zh: 「审计准则汇编」规定了函证必须如何发出。

examples.en: Trainees cite the statement of auditing standards in every working paper.
examples.zh: 新人在每张工作底稿里都要援引「审计准则汇编」。

collocations: sample the statement of auditing standards
vouch the statement of auditing standards
tie out the statement of auditing standards

words.enDefinition: a statement concerning auditing procedure

examples.en: The statement of auditing procedure lists the tests for each cycle.
examples.zh: 「审计程序汇编」逐项列明每个业务循环的测试。

examples.en: Where standards are silent, the statement of auditing procedure still guides the fieldwork.
examples.zh: 即使准则未作规定，「审计程序汇编」仍为现场工作提供指引。

collocations: accrue the statement of auditing procedure
restate the statement of auditing procedure
roll forward the statement of auditing procedure

words.enDefinition: a statement received from creditors

examples.en: The statement from creditors arrived with seventeen open invoices attached.
examples.zh: 「应付账款清单」寄到时附了十七张未结发票。

examples.en: Reconcile the statement from creditors against our payable ledger before paying anything.
examples.zh: 付款之前，先把「应付账款清单」与我们的应付明细账核对。

collocations: tie out the statement from creditors

words.enDefinition: a statement concerning final accounts

examples.en: The statement of final accounts closes the financial year each March.
examples.zh: 「会计决算报表」每年三月为财务年度收官。

examples.en: The council publishes its statement of final accounts within eight weeks.
examples.zh: 市政会在八周内公布「会计决算报表」。

collocations: accrue the statement of final accounts
restate the statement of final accounts
roll forward the statement of final accounts

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of state bond transfer

examples.en: The state bond transfer tax applies whenever the debentures change hands.
examples.zh: 公司债券一易手，就要缴纳「州公司债转让税」。

examples.en: Brokers collect the state bond transfer tax on settlement day automatically.
examples.zh: 券商在交割日自动代收「州公司债转让税」。

collocations: record the state bond transfer tax
disclose the state bond transfer tax
reconcile the state bond transfer tax

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of staple held for sale or use

examples.en: The staple stock of flour and sugar never leaves the reorder list.
examples.zh: 面粉和白糖这类「主要存货」永远在补货清单上。

examples.en: We protect staple stock from clearance pricing because customers expect it daily.
examples.zh: 顾客天天都要买，「主要存货」绝不参加清仓降价。

words.enDefinition: stock (equity or inventory) related to finished goods

examples.en: The finished goods stock of jumpers doubled ahead of the cold snap.
examples.zh: 寒潮来临之前，毛衣的「产成品盘存」翻了一倍。

examples.en: Counting the finished goods stock took the warehouse team two full days.
examples.zh: 清点「产成品盘存」让仓储班组整整忙了两天。

words.enDefinition: a stated policy or approach governing fiscal and tax

examples.en: The budget speech set fiscal and tax policy for the next three years.
examples.zh: 预算演说为未来三年定下了「财政税收政策」。

examples.en: Small firms read fiscal and tax policy before buying any new equipment.
examples.zh: 小企业购置新设备之前，都会先研究「财政税收政策」。

collocations: post the fiscal and tax policy
reconcile the fiscal and tax policy
disclose the fiscal and tax policy

words.enDefinition: a yearly period used for fiscal accounting

examples.en: Our fiscal accounting year ends on the last Saturday of March.
examples.zh: 我们的「会计年度」于三月最后一个星期六结束。

examples.en: The shortened fiscal accounting year aligned the group with its new parent.
examples.zh: 缩短后的「会计年度」让集团与新母公司同期结算。

words.enDefinition: accounting for depletion

examples.en: Depletion accounting spreads the quarry's price across the tonnes actually extracted.
examples.zh: 「折耗会计」把采石场的价款分摊到实际开采的吨数上。

examples.en: Under depletion accounting, the mine's carrying amount shrinks with each survey.
examples.zh: 在「折耗会计」下，矿山的账面价值随每次勘测递减。

words.enDefinition: an auditor of staff

examples.en: The staff auditor spent her first week entirely on bank confirmations.
examples.zh: 这位「雇用审计员」入职第一周全在处理银行函证。

examples.en: Our staff auditor caught the duplicated invoice the senior had passed over.
examples.zh: 高级审计员略过的重复发票，被「雇用审计员」逮了个正着。

words.enDefinition: a staff accounting bulletin issued by a regulator

examples.en: The staff accounting bulletin clarified how registrants treat convertible instruments.
examples.zh: 「专职会计公报」阐明了申报公司对可转换工具的处理。

examples.en: Regulators reference the staff accounting bulletin when reviewing IPO filings.
examples.zh: 监管机构审核 IPO 申报时会援引「专职会计公报」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for stabilized

examples.en: Stabilized accounting restates every figure into the currency's purchasing power.
examples.zh: 「稳定币值会计」把所有数字按货币购买力重新表述。

examples.en: During hyperinflation, stabilized accounting kept the plant's margins from looking imaginary.
